poulet-roti-citron-pommes-de-terre.title: Roast chicken with lemon and golden potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Arrange the chicken thighs and quartered potatoes in a dish with crushed garlic.
Drizzle with lemon juice and oil, sprinkle with herbs, salt, pepper and mix.
Bake for 50 minutes, turning halfway through, until the skin is golden.

poulet-curry-coco.title: Creamy chicken with curry and coconut milk
steps: Cook the rice according to the instructions on the package.
Brown the sliced onion in oil, then add the garlic, grated ginger and curry.
Add the diced chicken and brown for 5 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, salt and simmer for 15 minutes. Serve over rice.

poulet-moutarde-champignons.title: Chicken with mustard and mushrooms
steps: Cook the rice according to the instructions on the package.
Brown the chicken pieces in oil for 6 minutes, then set aside.
Sauté the shallot and sliced mushrooms for 5 minutes.
Add the chicken back in, stir in the cream and mustard, and simmer for 8 minutes.

poulet-tikka-yaourt-riz.title: Yogurt-marinated spiced chicken, aromatic rice
steps: Mix the yogurt, lemon juice, crushed garlic, curry, paprika and salt.
Coat the chicken cubes in this marinade and let rest for 15 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the instructions on the package.
Sear the chicken in a pan for 10 minutes, turning it, and serve over rice.

escalope-dinde-creme-champignons.title: Turkey cutlets with mushroom cream
steps: Peel the potatoes, cut them into pieces and cook for 20 minutes in salted water.
Brown the cutlets in butter for 4 minutes on each side, then set aside.
Sauté the onion and mushrooms, add the cream and let thicken for 5 minutes.
Coat the cutlets with sauce and serve with the potatoes.

poulet-basquaise.title: Basquaise chicken with peppers
steps: Brown the chicken thighs in oil in a pot, then set aside.
Sauté the onion and sliced peppers for 8 minutes with garlic and paprika.
Add the tomatoes and chicken, salt, cover and simmer for 35 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve with the chicken topped with sauce.

wraps-poulet-croquants.title: Crispy chicken wraps with yogurt sauce
steps: Cut the chicken into strips and brown for 8 minutes in oil with paprika and salt.
Mix the yogurt with the lemon juice.
Fill each wrap with lettuce, diced tomato, chicken and sauce.
Roll the wraps tightly and cut in half.

nuggets-poulet-maison-frites-four.title: Homemade chicken nuggets and oven fries
steps: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Cut the potatoes into sticks, coat with oil, salt and bake for 35 minutes.
Cut the chicken into pieces.
Dip them successively in flour, beaten eggs, then breadcrumbs mixed with paprika.
Arrange the nuggets on a tray and bake for 15 minutes, turning them halfway through.

brochettes-poulet-poivrons-yaourt.title: Chicken and pepper skewers, rice with yogurt
steps: Cut the chicken, peppers and onion into large cubes.
Marinate them with yogurt, paprika, oil and salt for 10 minutes.
Thread onto skewers alternately and cook for 12 minutes in a pan or oven, turning them.
Serve over cooked rice.

poulet-teriyaki-maison.title: Honey and soy glazed chicken, rice and broccoli
steps: Mix the soy sauce, honey, grated ginger and crushed garlic.
Steam the rice and broccoli florets.
Brown the chicken pieces in oil for 6 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and let caramelize for 4 minutes while stirring. Serve with the rice and broccoli.

chili-con-carne-riz.title: Hearty chili con carne
steps: Sauté the onion and diced pepper in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the ground beef and brown, breaking it apart.
Add the tomatoes, drained kidney beans, corn and spices, salt.
Simmer for 25 minutes on low, cook the rice and serve together.

pates-bolognaise-maison.title: Sunday spaghetti bolognese
steps: Sauté the onion and grated carrot in oil with garlic.
Add the ground beef, brown it, then add the paste, tomatoes, herbs and salt.
Simmer for 25 minutes on low.
Cook the pasta and serve topped with sauce.

boeuf-bourguignon-facile.title: Beef stew with carrots and mushrooms
steps: Brown the pieces of beef and bacon in a Dutch oven with the oil.
Sprinkle with flour, add the onion, carrots and the broth diluted in a large glass of water.
Cover and simmer for 2 hours over very low heat.
Add the mushrooms and potatoes for the last 30 minutes.

hachis-parmentier-classique.title: Oven-baked shepherd's pie
steps: Cook the peeled potatoes for 20 minutes in salted water, then mash with the butter and milk.
Sauté the onion, add the ground beef, season with salt and pepper and cook for 8 minutes.
Spread the meat in a dish, cover with mash and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes at 200°C.

burgers-maison-frites-four.title: Homemade burgers and oven fries
steps: Bake the oiled and salted potato sticks for 35 minutes at 210°C.
Form 4 patties with the ground beef, season with salt and pepper.
Cook for 4 minutes on each side, add the cheese at the end.
Fill the toasted buns with lettuce, tomato, onion and the patty.

boulettes-sauce-tomate-pates.title: Tender meatballs in tomato sauce
steps: Mix the beef, egg, breadcrumbs, crushed garlic and salt, then shape into meatballs.
Brown them for 6 minutes in oil with chopped onion.
Add tomatoes and herbs, cover and simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook the pasta and serve with the meatballs.

boeuf-saute-nouilles-legumes.title: Stir-fried noodles with beef and vegetables
steps: Cook the noodles as directed on the package and drain.
Brown the ground beef in oil with garlic and ginger.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook for 7 minutes.
Stir in the noodles and soy sauce, mix and serve.

lasagnes-bolognaise.title: Grandma's baked lasagna
steps: Sauté the onion, add the beef, then the tomatoes, season with salt and simmer for 15 minutes.
Prepare the béchamel: melt the butter, add the flour, then the milk whisking until thickened.
Layer the pasta sheets, meat and béchamel in a dish, finishing with cheese.
Bake for 35 minutes at 190°C.

poivrons-farcis-boeuf-riz.title: Stuffed peppers with beef and rice
steps: Preheat the oven to 190°C and cook the rice.
Sauté the onion and beef, add the rice, tomatoes, herbs and salt.
Hollow out the peppers, fill them with stuffing and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 35 minutes in a dish.

tacos-mexicains-maison.title: Mexican tacos for self-filling
steps: Brown the beef in oil with cumin, paprika and salt.
Add the drained red beans and corn and heat for 5 minutes.
Warm the tortillas and prepare lettuce, diced tomatoes and cheese.
Each person fills and folds their tortilla.

porc-miel-soja-haricots-verts.title: Pork with honey and soy, crunchy green beans
steps: Cook the rice. Cut the pork tenderloin into slices.
Brown them in oil with garlic for 6 minutes.
Add honey and soy sauce, let caramelize for 3 minutes.
Cook the green beans for 8 minutes in boiling water and serve with the rice.

saucisses-lentilles-carottes.title: Sausages with lentils and carrots
steps: Brown the sausages for 8 minutes in a Dutch oven with the oil.
Add the onion and diced carrots, then the rinsed lentils.
Cover with water and broth, season with salt and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with a touch of mustard.

gratin-pommes-de-terre-jambon.title: Potato and ham gratin
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut them into thin slices.
Arrange them in a garlic-rubbed dish with the ham in strips.
Mix cream, milk, salt and pepper, pour over the gratin and top with cheese.
Bake for 50 minutes at 180°C.

quiche-lorraine.title: Golden quiche Lorraine
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a tin with pastry.
Brown the bacon strips dry for 4 minutes and spread over the pastry.
Beat the eggs with cream, milk and pepper, then pour over the bacon.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake for 35 minutes.

filet-mignon-pommes-oignons.title: Pork tenderloin with apples and onions
steps: Boil the peeled potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes.
Brown the whole tenderloin in butter for 10 minutes on all sides.
Add the onion and quartered apples, cook for 10 minutes.
Pour in the cream, heat for 3 minutes, slice the tenderloin and serve.

croque-monsieur-maison.title: Melted croque-monsieur and salad
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Lightly butter the sandwich bread.
Top 4 slices with ham and cheese, close with the other slices.
Drizzle with a little milk and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake for 12 minutes until golden, serve with the salad.

saumon-citron-riz-brocoli.title: Salmon fillets with lemon, rice and broccoli
steps: Steam the rice and broccoli florets.
Salt and pepper the fillets, drizzle with oil and lemon.
Cook them in a pan for 4 minutes on each side.
Serve with the rice and broccoli.

papillote-cabillaud-legumes.title: Cod parcels with summer vegetables
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Slice the vegetables thinly.
On 4 sheets of baking paper, place vegetables, fish, lemon and herbs.
Drizzle with oil, salt, then close the parcels.
Bake for 20 minutes.

colin-creme-poireaux-pommes-de-terre.title: Hake with leek cream
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes.
Sauté the sliced leeks in butter for 10 minutes.
Add the cream, place the fish on top, cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Serve with the potatoes.

gratin-poisson-epinards.title: Fish and spinach gratin
steps: Cook the rice and preheat the oven to 200°C.
Spread the spinach in a dish and place the fish on top.
Mix cream, salt and pepper, pour over and cover with cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes and serve with the rice.

pates-thon-tomate-olives.title: Quick pasta with tuna, tomatoes and olives
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté the onion in oil, add the tomatoes and herbs.
Crumble the tuna, add the olives and heat for 8 minutes.
Mix with the drained pasta.

crevettes-ail-citron-pates.title: Pasta with shrimp, garlic and lemon
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté the minced garlic in oil for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and cook for 4 minutes with the lemon juice.
Mix with the pasta and chopped parsley.

curry-cabillaud-coco-riz.title: Cod curry with coconut milk
steps: Cook the rice. Sauté the sliced bell pepper with ginger and curry powder.
Pour in the coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the fish in large pieces and cook for 8 minutes on low heat.
Serve over the rice with coriander.

saumon-laque-miel-soja.title: Salmon glazed with honey and soy
steps: Cook the rice and green beans.
Mix the honey and soy sauce.
Sear the fillets in oil for 3 minutes on each side.
Pour in the sauce, let caramelize for 2 minutes and serve.

spaghettis-sardines-citron.title: Spaghetti with sardines, lemon and cherry tomatoes
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté the garlic and halved cherry tomatoes in oil.
Add the crumbled sardines, zest and juice of the lemon.
Mix with the pasta and parsley.

fish-and-chips-four.title: Oven-baked breaded fish and fries, peas
steps: Bake the oiled and salted fries for 35 minutes at 210°C.
Dust the fish with flour, dip in beaten egg, then coat with breadcrumbs.
Place it on an oiled tray and bake for 15 minutes.
Cook the peas for 5 minutes and serve.

risotto-saumon-fume-epinards.title: Creamy risotto with smoked salmon and spinach
steps: Dissolve the cubes in 1 liter of hot water. Sauté the onion in the oil.
Add the rice, toast for 2 minutes, then pour the broth in ladle by ladle for 18 minutes.
Stir in the spinach, cream, and parmesan.
Add the smoked salmon in strips just before serving.

curry-pois-chiches-epinards.title: Vegetable curry with chickpeas and spinach
steps: Cook the rice. Sauté the onion, garlic, and ginger in the oil.
Add the curry, tomatoes, drained chickpeas, and coconut milk.
Simmer for 15 minutes, add salt.
Add the spinach 2 minutes before the end and serve over the rice.

dahl-lentilles-carottes.title: Lentil dahl with carrots
steps: Sauté the onion and diced carrots in oil with the spices.
Add the rinsed lentils, tomatoes, and 600 ml water.
Simmer for 25 minutes, then pour in the coconut milk and add salt.
Cook the rice and serve with the dahl.

chili-sin-carne-riz.title: Vegetarian chili with red beans
steps: Sauté the onion and diced pepper in oil.
Add the spices, tomatoes, drained beans, and corn.
Simmer for 25 minutes on low heat.
Cook the rice and serve.

ratatouille-provencale-riz.title: Provençal ratatouille
steps: Cut all the vegetables into cubes.
Sauté them separately in oil, starting with the eggplant.
Combine them in a pot with the garlic, herbs, and salt.
Simmer for 30 minutes covered, cook the rice and serve.

gratin-courgettes-chevre.title: Zucchini and goat cheese gratin
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Slice the zucchinis.
Place them in a dish with crumbled goat cheese.
Beat eggs, cream, herbs, salt, and pepper and pour over the vegetables.
Sprinkle with cheese and bake for 35 minutes.

lasagnes-legumes-ricotta.title: Vegetable lasagna with ricotta
steps: Sauté diced zucchinis and eggplants in oil for 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and salt, simmer for 10 minutes.
Layer sheets, vegetables, and ricotta in a dish, finish with mozzarella.
Bake for 35 minutes at 190 °C and sprinkle with basil.

omelette-champignons-pommes-de-terre.title: Omelette with mushrooms and sautéed potatoes
steps: Cook diced potatoes for 12 minutes in water, then drain.
Brown them in butter with sliced mushrooms.
Pour in beaten eggs, salted and peppered, cook for 6 minutes on low heat.
Serve with chives and salad.

tarte-fine-tomates-chevre.title: Thin tomato and goat cheese tart
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and spread the dough on a tray.
Brush it with mustard.
Cover with tomato slices and goat cheese, sprinkle with herbs.
Bake for 25 minutes and serve with salad.

saute-tofu-legumes-sesame.title: Stir-fried tofu with vegetables and ginger
steps: Cook the rice. Cut the tofu into cubes and brown them in oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger, and stir-fry vegetables.
Cook for 7 minutes, then pour in the soy sauce.
Serve over the rice.

falafels-four-houmous.title: Baked falafels, sesame sauce, and pitas
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Blend chickpeas, onion, parsley, cumin, flour, and salt.
Shape into balls and bake for 25 minutes, turning them over.
Mix tahini, lemon juice, and a little water.
Fill the pitas with falafels, tomato, cucumber, and sauce.

gnocchi-poeles-tomates-mozzarella.title: Pan-seared gnocchi with cherry tomatoes and mozzarella
steps: Brown the gnocchi in oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and halved cherry tomatoes.
Cook for 5 minutes, then add the mozzarella in pieces.
Serve with basil.

pates-pesto-courgettes.title: Pasta with pesto, zucchini and cherry tomatoes
steps: Cook the pasta.
Sauté the diced zucchini in oil for 6 minutes.
Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes.
Mix with the pasta and pesto.

risotto-champignons-parmesan.title: Risotto with mushrooms and parmesan
steps: Dissolve the bouillon cubes in 1 liter of hot water. Sauté the onion and mushrooms in butter.
Add the rice, toast for 2 minutes, then add the broth one ladle at a time.
Cook for 18 minutes, stirring.
Finish with parmesan.

veloute-courge-chevre-croutons.title: Squash soup with croutons and goat cheese
steps: Sauté the onion, then add the diced squash and potatoes.
Cover with water, add the bouillon and cook for 25 minutes.
Blend with the cream and add salt.
Serve with slices of toasted baguette and goat cheese.

pizza-maison-margherita.title: Homemade margherita pizza
steps: Mix flour, yeast, salt, oil and 180 ml of lukewarm water, knead for 5 minutes.
Rest for 20 minutes, then roll out the dough.
Top with tomatoes and mozzarella.
Bake for 15 minutes at 230 °C and sprinkle with basil.

galettes-pommes-de-terre-fromage.title: Crispy potato cakes with cheese
steps: Grate the potatoes and onion, squeeze well.
Mix with eggs, flour, cheese and salt.
Form patties and brown in oil for 5 minutes on each side.
Serve with salad.

curry-patate-douce-pois-chiches.title: Sweet potato and chickpea curry
steps: Sauté the onion and curry in oil.
Add the diced sweet potato and coconut milk, simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and spinach for 3 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve.

shakshuka-oeufs-tomates.title: Shakshuka, eggs poached in tomato sauce
steps: Sauté the onion and sliced bell pepper in oil.
Add spices, tomatoes and salt, simmer for 12 minutes.
Make wells, crack in the eggs and cover for 7 minutes.
Serve with baguette.

buddha-bowl-quinoa-patate-douce.title: Buddha bowl with quinoa and roasted sweet potato
steps: Roast the diced sweet potato for 25 minutes at 200 °C with oil.
Cook the quinoa for 12 minutes.
Mix tahini, lemon, salt and a little water.
Assemble the bowls with quinoa, sweet potato, chickpeas, spinach, avocado and sauce.

boulgour-legumes-roties-feta.title: Bulgur with roasted vegetables and feta
steps: Roast diced zucchini and bell pepper for 25 minutes at 200 °C with oil.
Cook the bulgur for 12 minutes in salted water.
Mix with the vegetables, lemon juice and mint.
Sprinkle with crumbled feta.

quesadillas-haricots-fromage.title: Quesadillas with beans and cheese
steps: Roughly mash the beans with cumin.
Spread on 4 tortillas, add corn, diced tomato and cheese.
Cover with the 4 other tortillas.
Brown for 3 minutes per side in a pan and cut into pieces.

spaghettis-ail-huile-persil.title: Spaghetti with garlic, olive oil and parsley
steps: Cook the pasta in plenty of salted water.
Gently heat the oil with minced garlic and chili.
Add the drained pasta and a little cooking water.
Mix with chopped parsley.

gratin-chou-fleur-fromage.title: Cauliflower gratin with béchamel
steps: Cook the florets for 10 minutes in water.
Prepare the béchamel: butter, flour, then whisk in milk.
Arrange the cauliflower in a dish, cover with sauce and cheese.
Gratin for 25 minutes at 200 °C.

pates-petits-pois-fromage.title: Creamy pasta with peas
steps: Cook the pasta, add the peas 4 minutes before the end.
Drain, keeping a little of the cooking water.
Return to the pot with the cream and heat for 2 minutes.
Add the cheese and mix.

pommes-de-terre-farcies-fromage-blanc.title: Baked potatoes stuffed with fromage blanc
steps: Bake the whole potatoes for 45 minutes at 200°C.
Open them and mash the flesh with the fromage blanc, chives and salt.
Fill the skins and sprinkle with cheese.
Grill for 10 minutes and serve with the salad.

soupe-lentilles-carottes.title: Thick lentil and carrot soup
steps: Sauté the onion and sliced carrots in oil.
Add rinsed lentils, cumin, stock and 1.2 liters of water.
Cook for 30 minutes.
Partially blend and serve with bread.

nouilles-sautees-legumes-oeuf.title: Rice noodles stir-fried with egg and vegetables
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water for 5 minutes.
Stir-fry the vegetables in oil for 6 minutes, push to the side and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles and soy sauce.
Serve with crushed peanuts and lemon.

couscous-poulet-legumes.title: Couscous with chicken and vegetables
steps: Brown the chicken with onion in oil.
Add spices, tomato paste, carrots and 1 liter of water, simmer for 30 minutes.
Add zucchini and chickpeas, cook for 15 minutes.
Soak the couscous with hot water and serve with the broth.

tajine-agneau-patate-douce.title: Lamb tagine with sweet potato
steps: Brown the lamb pieces with onion in oil.
Add the spices and cover with water to the level of the meat.
Simmer for 1 hour, then add sweet potato and chickpeas for 30 minutes.
Soak the couscous and serve.

boulettes-kefta-semoule.title: Kefta meatballs in tomato sauce, semolina
steps: Mix the beef, chopped onion, parsley, spices and salt.
Form meatballs and brown them in oil.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes.
Soak the semolina and serve.

paella-poulet-chorizo.title: Paella with chicken and chorizo
steps: Brown the chicken and chorizo slices in oil, then set aside.
Sauté the onion and bell pepper, add the rice and tomatoes.
Pour in 700 ml of hot stock, add the meat back in, cook for 20 minutes.
Add the peas at the end of cooking.

riz-cantonais-maison.title: Homemade Cantonese rice
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool slightly.
Stir-fry the diced carrot and peas in oil for 5 minutes.
Push to the side, scramble the eggs, add the diced ham.
Add the rice and soy sauce, stir-fry for 5 minutes.

bol-vietnamien-boeuf-nouilles.title: Vietnamese bowl with beef and rice noodles
steps: Cook the noodles and cool them under water.
Brown the beef with soy sauce in oil.
Prepare lettuce, grated carrot, cucumber and mint.
Assemble the bowls and add peanuts and lemon.

poulet-yassa-oignons-citron.title: Yassa chicken with caramelized onions and lemon
steps: Marinate the chicken with lemon juice, mustard and salt for 15 minutes.
Brown the chicken in oil and set aside.
Soften the sliced onions for 20 minutes over low heat.
Put the chicken back, simmer for 10 minutes and serve with rice.

fajitas-poulet-poivrons.title: Chicken and bell pepper fajitas
steps: Slice chicken, bell peppers and onion into strips.
Stir-fry in oil with spices for 10 minutes.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with chicken, vegetables and a spoonful of yogurt.

gyros-poulet-pita-tzatziki.title: Grilled chicken pitas, tzatziki sauce
steps: Mix yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic and mint for the sauce.
Brown the chicken strips with paprika in the oil.
Warm the pitas.
Fill with chicken, tomato and sauce.

moussaka-simplifiee.title: Simplified moussaka
steps: Roast the eggplant slices for 15 minutes at 200°C with the oil.
Sauté the onion and beef, add the tomatoes.
Make a béchamel sauce with butter, flour and milk.
Layer eggplant and meat, cover with béchamel and cheese, bake for 30 minutes.

tartiflette-gourmande.title: Gourmet tartiflette
steps: Cook the potato slices for 15 minutes in water.
Sauté the bacon and onion.
Arrange everything in a dish with cream and pepper, cover with cheese.
Grill for 25 minutes at 200°C.

pot-au-feu-familial.title: Family pot-au-feu
steps: Cover the beef with cold water in a large pot with broth and onion.
Bring to a simmer and cook for 2 hours, skimming off the foam.
Add carrots, leeks and potatoes for the last 35 minutes.
Serve with mustard.

blanquette-dinde-riz.title: Turkey blanquette with rice
steps: Sauté the onion, carrots and turkey pieces in butter.
Sprinkle with flour, cover with water and broth, and cook for 30 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 10 minutes.
Thicken with cream and serve over rice.

gratin-macaronis-jambon.title: Ham macaroni gratin
steps: Cook the pasta 2 minutes less than indicated.
Mix with diced ham, cream, milk and half of the cheese.
Pour into a dish and cover with remaining cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes at 200°C.

bol-riz-saumon-fume-avocat.title: Rice bowl with smoked salmon and avocado
steps: Cook the rice and let cool slightly.
Slice avocados and cucumber.
Arrange the rice in bowls with smoked salmon.
Season with soy sauce and lemon juice.

salade-cesar-poulet.title: Caesar salad with chicken and homemade croutons
steps: Cut the baguette into cubes and brown in a pan with oil.
Cook the chicken strips for 8 minutes.
Mix yogurt, lemon, mustard and salt.
Assemble salad, chicken, croutons, parmesan and dressing.

salade-chevre-chaud-noix.title: Warm goat cheese, apple and walnut salad
steps: Cut the baguette into slices and place a piece of goat cheese on each.
Drizzle with honey and bake for 8 minutes at 200°C.
Prepare the salad with diced apple and walnuts.
Dress with oil and vinegar and add the cheese toasts.

salade-lentilles-lardons.title: Warm lentil and bacon salad
steps: Cook the lentils for 20 minutes in water.
Sauté the bacon.
Mix mustard, vinegar, oil and salt.
Combine lentils, bacon, grated carrot and sliced shallot.

spaghettis-carbonara.title: Spaghetti carbonara
steps: Cook the pasta.
Brown the bacon in a dry pan.
Beat the eggs with parmesan and pepper.
Off the heat, mix pasta, bacon and sauce, add a little cooking water.

tagliatelles-saumon-creme.title: Tagliatelle with salmon and lemon
steps: Cook the pasta.
Cook the diced salmon for 4 minutes in a pan.
Add cream and lemon juice, heat for 2 minutes.
Mix with the pasta and chives.

tortilla-espagnole.title: Spanish tortilla with potatoes
steps: Gently cook the sliced potatoes and onion in oil for 15 minutes.
Mix them with the beaten and salted eggs.
Cook in the pan for 6 minutes, turn over with the help of a plate.
Cook for another 4 minutes and serve with salad.

soupe-nouilles-poulet.title: Chicken and ginger noodle soup
steps: Dissolve the stock cubes in 1.2 liters of hot water with the ginger.
Add the sliced chicken, carrot and mushrooms, cook for 8 minutes.
Add the noodles for 3 minutes.
Serve with soy sauce and coriander.

rougail-saucisses.title: Rougail sausages
steps: Pierce and brown the sausages in oil.
Add the onion, garlic and ginger.
Add the tomatoes and chili, simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve.

mini-pizzas-pita.title: Mini pizzas on pita bread
steps: Preheat the oven to 210°C.
Spread the tomato sauce and herbs on the pitas.
Add the sliced ham and mozzarella.
Bake for 10 minutes until the cheese is golden.

veloute-carottes-cumin.title: Carrot and cumin soup
steps: Sauté the onion in oil.
Add carrots, potato, cumin, stock and 800 ml water.
Cook for 25 minutes.
Blend until smooth.

soupe-poireaux-pommes-de-terre.title: Leek and potato soup
steps: Soften the sliced leeks in butter for 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes, stock and 800 ml water.
Cook for 25 minutes.
Blend with the cream and sprinkle with chives.

gaspacho-tomate-concombre.title: Fresh tomato and cucumber gazpacho
steps: Roughly chop all the vegetables.
Blend with bread, garlic, oil, vinegar and salt.
Let it chill in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Serve very cold.

salade-tomate-mozzarella-basilic.title: Tomato, mozzarella and basil salad
steps: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella.
Arrange them alternately in a dish.
Add the basil leaves.
Season with oil, salt and pepper.

salade-betterave-pomme-feta.title: Beetroot, apple and feta salad
steps: Dice the beetroot and apple.
Crumble the feta and break the walnuts.
Mix everything together.
Dress with oil and vinegar.

oeufs-mimosa-yaourt.title: Light deviled eggs
steps: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool them.
Cut them in half and mash the yolks.
Mix the yolks with yogurt, mustard and salt.
Fill the whites and sprinkle with chives.

houmous-crudites-pita.title: Homemade hummus, crudités and pita
steps: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, salt and a little water.
Cut carrot and cucumber into sticks.
Warm the pitas and cut them.
Serve for dipping.

taboule-frais-menthe.title: Fresh tabbouleh with mint
steps: Pour the same amount of hot water over the couscous and let it swell for 5 minutes.
Dice the tomatoes and cucumber finely.
Mix with the chopped herbs.
Add lemon juice, oil and salt.

carottes-rapees-orange.title: Grated carrots with orange
steps: Grate the carrots.
Squeeze the orange to obtain its juice.
Mix with the oil and the salt.
Sprinkle with parsley.

avocats-farcis-thon.title: Avocados stuffed with tuna
steps: Cut the avocados in half and remove the pit.
Mix the crumbled tuna, yogurt, lemon, salt and pepper.
Fill the avocados with the mixture.
Serve chilled.

feuilletes-chevre-miel.title: Goat cheese and honey puffs
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the dough into 8 squares.
Place a slice of goat cheese on each square.
Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with herbs.
Bake for 15 minutes.

concombre-yaourt-menthe.title: Fresh cucumber with yogurt and mint
steps: Cut the cucumbers into thin slices.
Mix the yogurt, crushed garlic, mint and salt.
Add the cucumbers.
Serve very chilled.

soupe-tomate-basilic.title: Tomato soup with basil
steps: Sauté the onion in oil.
Add the tomatoes, broth and 300 ml of water, cook for 15 minutes.
Blend with the basil.
Add the cream and heat.

salade-pois-chiches-feta.title: Chickpea salad with cucumber and feta
steps: Drain the chickpeas.
Cut the cucumber and cherry tomatoes.
Crumble the feta on top.
Season with lemon and oil.

veloute-champignons.title: Creamy mushroom soup
steps: Sauté chopped onion and mushrooms in butter.
Add the diced potato, broth and 600 ml of water.
Cook for 20 minutes.
Blend with the cream.

bruschettas-tomate-basilic.title: Tomato and basil bruschetta
steps: Slice the baguette and toast it.
Rub the slices with garlic.
Mix diced tomatoes, basil, oil and salt.
Top the toasts.

salade-chou-carotte-yaourt.title: Crunchy cabbage and carrot salad
steps: Thinly slice the cabbage and grate the carrot.
Mix yogurt, mustard, vinegar and salt.
Season the vegetables.
Let rest for 10 minutes before serving.

mousse-chocolat-noir.title: Intense dark chocolate mousse
steps: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler.
Separate whites from yolks and add the yolks to the cooled chocolate.
Whip the egg whites with the sugar until stiff.
Gently fold in and refrigerate for 3 hours.

crumble-pommes-cannelle.title: Apple cinnamon crumble
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Peel the apples, dice them, and place in a dish with the cinnamon.
Rub flour, cold butter and sugar together with your fingertips.
Spread over the apples.
Bake for 35 minutes.

tarte-pommes-feuilletee.title: Thin apple tart
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C and roll out the dough.
Arrange the apples in thin slices.
Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon, dot with butter.
Bake for 35 minutes.

gateau-au-yaourt-classique.title: Moist Yogurt Cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Mix yogurt, sugar, eggs and oil.
Add flour and baking powder.
Pour into a pan and bake for 35 minutes.

riz-au-lait-vanille.title: Vanilla Rice Pudding
steps: Rinse the rice.
Cook it in milk with the vanilla over low heat.
Stir often for 40 minutes.
Add the sugar at the end of cooking and let cool slightly.

fondant-chocolat-coeur-coulant.title: Chocolate Fondant
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Melt the chocolate and butter.
Add sugar, eggs then flour.
Pour into molds and bake for 10 to 12 minutes.

salade-fruits-frais-menthe.title: Fresh Fruit Salad with Mint
steps: Peel and dice all the fruits.
Drizzle with lemon juice.
Add the chopped mint.
Chill for 30 minutes.

fromage-blanc-miel-noix.title: Quark with Honey and Walnuts
steps: Divide the quark into 4 bowls.
Drizzle with honey.
Sprinkle with chopped walnuts.
Serve chilled.

crepes-faciles.title: Thin and Soft Crepes
steps: Mix flour, sugar and eggs, then gradually add the milk.
Add the melted butter.
Let rest for 20 minutes.
Cook in a hot pan, 1 minute per side.

compote-pommes-maison.title: Homemade Apple Compote
steps: Peel and cut the apples.
Cook covered with 5 cl of water and the cinnamon.
Mash with a fork after 20 minutes.
Add the sugar and let cool.

tiramisu-fraises-speculoos.title: Strawberry Tiramisu with Shortbread
steps: Separate the whites from the yolks.
Whisk the yolks and sugar, then add the mascarpone.
Fold in the stiff egg whites.
Layer in glasses with shortbread and strawberries, refrigerate for 4 hours.

gateau-banane-moelleux.title: Moist Banana Cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Mash the bananas and add sugar, eggs and melted butter.
Fold in flour and baking powder.
Bake for 40 minutes in a pan.

poires-chocolat-chaud.title: Poached Pears with Chocolate Sauce
steps: Peel the pears and cook for 15 minutes in simmering water.
Melt the chocolate with the cream.
Drain the pears.
Serve topped with warm sauce.

cookies-pepites-chocolat.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Mix softened butter, sugar and egg.
Add flour, baking powder and chocolate pieces.
Shape balls on a baking tray and bake for 12 minutes.

porridge-pomme-cannelle.title: Hot Apple Cinnamon Porridge
steps: Heat the milk with the oats over low heat.
Stir for 5 minutes until thickened.
Add grated apple and cinnamon.
Serve drizzled with honey.

pancakes-moelleux-banane.title: Fluffy banana pancakes
steps: Mix flour, baking powder, sugar, eggs, milk and melted butter.
Let rest for 5 minutes.
Cook small ladles for 2 minutes per side.
Serve with the banana in slices.

tartines-avocat-oeuf.title: Avocado and poached egg toasts
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with the lemon, salt and pepper.
Cook the eggs fried or poached.
Spread avocado on the bread and place the eggs.

granola-maison-miel.title: Homemade crunchy granola
steps: Preheat the oven to 160 °C.
Mix flakes, crushed nuts, oil, honey and cinnamon.
Spread on a baking tray.
Bake for 20 minutes, stirring halfway through.

oeufs-brouilles-toasts.title: Creamy scrambled eggs and toasts
steps: Toast the slices of bread.
Beat the eggs with the salt.
Cook them gently in butter while stirring.
Serve with tomato and chives.

bol-yaourt-fruits-granola.title: Yogurt bowl with red fruits and flakes
steps: Divide the yogurt into 4 bowls.
Add the banana in slices and the red fruits.
Sprinkle with flakes.
Drizzle with honey.

pain-perdu-cannelle.title: Cinnamon French toast
steps: Beat eggs, milk, sugar and cinnamon.
Dip the bread slices for a few seconds.
Brown them in butter for 3 minutes per side.
Serve warm.

smoothie-banane-fraise.title: Creamy banana and strawberry smoothie
steps: Cut the banana into slices.
Put all the ingredients in a blender.
Blend for 1 minute.
Serve immediately.

overnight-oats-fruits-rouges.title: Morning oats with red fruits
steps: The day before, mix flakes, yogurt, milk and honey.
Divide into 4 jars and add the red fruits.
Close and refrigerate overnight.
Enjoy cold.

boeuf-carottes-mijote.title: Braised beef with carrots
steps: Cut the beef into large cubes, slice the carrots into rounds and thinly slice the onions.
Brown the meat in a Dutch oven with the oil, then add the onions and chopped garlic.
Sprinkle with flour, mix, then add the tomatoes, crumbled stock cube, thyme, bay leaf and 60 cl water.
Cover and simmer for 1 h over low heat.
Add the carrots and continue cooking for 1 h 30, until the meat is tender. Remove the bay leaf.

carbonade-flamande.title: Flemish beef stew with beer
steps: Cut the beef into pieces and thinly slice the onions.
Brown the meat in a Dutch oven with the butter, set aside, then cook the onions with the sugar for 10 minutes.
Return the meat, pour in the beer, add the thyme and bay leaf.
Spread the slices of country bread with mustard and place them on top.
Cover and simmer for 2 h 30 over low heat, stirring occasionally. Remove the bay leaf.

daube-provencale.title: Provençal beef stew
steps: Cut the beef into cubes, slice the carrots into rounds and thinly slice the onions. Cut a strip of orange zest.
Brown the meat in a Dutch oven with the oil, add the onions and chopped garlic.
Pour in the wine, bring to a boil for 5 minutes, then add the carrots, tomatoes, Provençal herbs, bay leaf and zest.
Cover and simmer for 2 h 45 over very low heat.
Add the olives 15 minutes before the end, then remove the bay leaf and zest.

blanquette-veau-riz.title: Veal blanquette with rice
steps: Put the veal cubes in a Dutch oven, cover with cold water and add the stock cube, bring to a boil and skim.
Add the sliced carrots, leek, onion and bay leaf, then simmer for 1 h 15 over low heat.
Sauté the sliced button mushrooms in a little butter and cook the rice separately.
Melt the remaining butter, add the flour then 50 cl of the cooking broth, whisking until thickened.
Off the heat, add the crème fraîche and lemon juice, then the meat, carrots and mushrooms. Serve with the rice.

veau-marengo.title: Veal Marengo stew
steps: Cut the veal into cubes, thinly slice the onions and mushrooms.
Brown the meat in a Dutch oven with the oil, add the onions and chopped garlic, then sprinkle with flour.
Pour in the wine, add the tomatoes, Provençal herbs, bay leaf and 20 cl water.
Cover and simmer for 1 h 15 over low heat.
Add the mushrooms and cook for another 20 minutes. Remove the bay leaf.

veau-olives-carottes.title: Veal stew with olives and carrots
steps: Cut the veal into cubes, slice the carrots into rounds and thinly slice the onion.
Brown the meat in a Dutch oven with the oil, add the onion and chopped garlic.
Add the carrots, tomatoes, thyme and 25 cl water.
Cover and simmer for 1 h 30 over low heat.
Add the olives, reheat for 5 minutes and serve.

navarin-agneau-printanier.title: Spring lamb navarin
steps: Cut the lamb into pieces. Brown in a Dutch oven with the oil, then add the sliced onion and chopped garlic.
Sprinkle with flour, add the tomato paste, thyme, bay leaf and 80 cl water.
Cover and simmer for 1 h over low heat.
Add the carrots, turnips and potatoes cut into pieces, then cook for 30 minutes.
Add the frozen peas, cook for 10 minutes and remove the bay leaf.

agneau-haricots-blancs.title: Lamb shoulder with white beans
steps: Cut the lamb into pieces. Thinly slice the onion and chop the garlic.
Brown the meat in a Dutch oven with the oil, add the onion and garlic.
Add the tomatoes, thyme, bay leaf and 30 cl water.
Cover and simmer for 1 h 45 over low heat.
Add the drained canned white beans, cook for another 15 minutes and remove the bay leaf.

poulet-chasseur.title: Hunter's chicken
steps: Brown the chicken legs in a Dutch oven with the oil, then set aside.
Sauté the sliced shallots and button mushrooms, add the chopped garlic.
Pour in the wine, reduce for 3 minutes, then add the tomatoes and thyme.
Return the chicken, cover and simmer for 45 minutes over low heat.

coq-au-vin-cuisses.title: Coq au vin with chicken legs
steps: Brown the chicken legs in a Dutch oven with the oil, then set aside.
Sauté the bacon bits, sliced onion, sliced carrots and chopped garlic. Sprinkle with flour.
Return the chicken, pour in the wine, add the thyme and bay leaf.
Cover and simmer for 1 h over low heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms, cook for 15 minutes and remove the bay leaf.

poulet-vallee-auge.title: Chicken with cider and cream
steps: Brown the chicken legs in a Dutch oven with the butter, then set aside.
Sauté the sliced onion and button mushrooms.
Return the chicken, pour in the cider, cover and cook for 35 minutes over low heat.
Add the apples cut into quarters and cook for 10 minutes.
Remove the chicken and apples, add the single cream, reduce for 3 minutes and drizzle over.

poulet-estragon-creme.title: Chicken with tarragon and cream
steps: Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Cut the chicken into pieces and brown them in a pan with the butter and sliced shallots.
Add the single cream, mustard and dried tarragon, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve with the rice.

poule-au-pot-simple.title: Simple chicken leg pot-au-feu
steps: Put the chicken leg and whole onion in a large pot, cover with 2.5 litres of water along with the stock cube, dried thyme and bay leaf.
Bring to a boil, skim off the foam and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the carrots, leeks and turnips cut into chunks, then cook for 25 minutes.
Add the potatoes in pieces and cook for another 25 minutes.
Serve the chicken and vegetables with a little broth. Remove the bay leaf.

poulet-vinaigre-lyonnais.title: Chicken with vinegar Lyon-style
steps: Brown the chicken legs in a sauté pan with the butter, 10 minutes on each side.
Add the sliced shallots and chopped garlic, then sauté for 3 minutes.
Pour in the vinegar, let it reduce, then add the chopped tomatoes and 10 cl of water.
Cover and cook for 25 minutes on low heat, then add the single cream and let thicken for 3 minutes.

fricassee-poulet-poireaux.title: Chicken and leek fricassee
steps: Cook the potatoes in pieces for 20 minutes in salted water.
Cut the chicken fillet into pieces and slice the leeks.
Brown the chicken in a sauté pan with the butter, add the leeks and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the single cream and mustard, simmer for 5 minutes and serve with the potatoes.

poulet-olives-tomates.title: Chicken with olives and tomatoes
steps: Brown the chicken legs in a Dutch oven with the olive oil, then set aside.
Sauté the sliced onion and bell pepper strips, then add the chopped garlic.
Add the chopped tomatoes and Provençal herbs, put the chicken back in, cover and simmer for 40 minutes.
Add the olives, cook for 5 minutes and serve.

saute-dinde-carottes-curry.title: Turkey sauté with carrots and mild curry
steps: Cut the turkey escalope into pieces, the carrots into rounds and slice the onion.
Brown the turkey in a Dutch oven with the olive oil, add the onion and curry.
Add the carrots and 30 cl of water, cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the single cream, let thicken for 3 minutes and serve.

dinde-normande-pommes.title: Normandy-style turkey escalopes
steps: Cut the apples into quarters and brown for 8 minutes in half the butter, then set aside.
Brown the escalopes with the rest of the butter and the sliced onion, 4 minutes on each side.
Add the single cream and apples, simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper and serve piping hot.

lapin-moutarde.title: Rabbit with mustard
steps: Brush the rabbit pieces with mustard.
Brown them in a Dutch oven with the butter, then add the sliced shallots.
Pour in the dry white wine, add the dried thyme, cover and simmer for 45 minutes on low heat.
Add the single cream, let reduce for 5 minutes and serve.

lapin-pruneaux.title: Rabbit with prunes
steps: Brown the rabbit pieces in a Dutch oven with the olive oil, then set aside.
Sauté the sliced onion and carrots cut into rounds.
Put the rabbit back in, pour in the dry white wine, add the dried thyme, bay leaf and 10 cl of water.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add the pitted prunes and cook for another 20 minutes. Remove the bay leaf.

canard-navets.title: Duck legs with turnips
steps: Brown the duck legs skin side down in a dry Dutch oven for 10 minutes, then set aside.
Pour off almost all the fat, sauté the sliced onion and turnips in pieces with the sugar.
Put the duck back in, add the dried thyme, stock cube and 30 cl of water.
Cover and simmer for 50 minutes on low heat.

canard-petits-pois.title: Duck legs with peas
steps: Brown the duck legs skin side down in a dry Dutch oven for 10 minutes, then set aside.
Pour off almost all the fat, sauté the bacon bits, sliced onion and carrots cut into rounds.
Put the duck back in, add the dried thyme, stock cube and 25 cl of water, cover and simmer for 35 minutes.
Add the frozen peas and cook for 12 minutes.

cassoulet-simple.title: Simple cassoulet
steps: Preheat the oven to 160 °C.
Brown the duck leg skin side down in a Dutch oven, then the pork sausages. Set aside.
Sauté the bacon bits, sliced onion and chopped garlic, add the chopped tomatoes, dried thyme and bay leaf.
Add the drained canned white beans, duck cut into pieces and sausages, then 30 cl of water.
Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake for 1 h uncovered. Remove the bay leaf.

potee-auvergnate.title: Auvergne-style potée
steps: Desalt the salted pork for 30 minutes in cold water, then put it in a large pot with 3 litres of water.
Bring to a boil, skim off the foam, add the onion and bay leaf, then simmer for 1 h.
Add the savoy cabbage in quarters, carrots, turnips, leeks and smoked pork sausage, then cook for 30 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cook for another 30 minutes. Remove the bay leaf, taste before adding salt.

choucroute-garnie-simple.title: Simplified Choucroute Garnie
steps: Rinse the raw sauerkraut and drain it. Slice the onion.
Sauté the onion in a large Dutch oven, add half of the raw sauerkraut, the salted pork and the bay leaf, then the rest of the raw sauerkraut.
Pour in the dry white wine and 20 cl of water, cover and simmer for 1 h over low heat.
Add the smoked pork sausage, pork sausage, and the peeled potatoes, then cook for another 35 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf and serve.

petit-sale-lentilles.title: Salted Pork with Lentils
steps: Desalt the salted pork for 30 minutes in cold water.
Place it in a Dutch oven, cover with water, add the onion, dried thyme and bay leaf, then simmer for 1 h.
Add the rinsed lentils and the carrots cut into rounds, then cook for 30 minutes.
Drain if needed, remove the bay leaf, taste before adding salt, and serve.

saute-porc-moutarde.title: Pork Stew with Mustard
steps: Cut the pork shoulder into cubes and slice the onions.
Brown the meat in a Dutch oven with olive oil, add the onions.
Add the stock cube, dried thyme and 30 cl of water, cover and simmer for 50 minutes.
Add the mustard and single cream, let reduce for 5 minutes.

porc-pommes-cidre.title: Pork Stew with Apples and Cider
steps: Cut the pork shoulder into cubes, slice the onions.
Brown the meat in a Dutch oven with olive oil, add the onions, then sprinkle with flour.
Pour in the dry cider, add the dried thyme, cover and simmer for 1 h.
Add the apples cut into quarters and cook for 15 minutes.

saute-porc-pruneaux.title: Pork Stew with Prunes
steps: Cut the pork shoulder into cubes, the carrots into rounds and slice the onions.
Brown the meat in a Dutch oven with olive oil, add the onions and carrots.
Pour in the dry white wine and 20 cl of water, add the dried thyme, cover and simmer for 50 minutes.
Add the pitted prunes and cook for another 20 minutes.

chou-farci-familial.title: Family-Style Stuffed Cabbage
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Blanch 12 large Savoy cabbage leaves for 5 minutes in boiling water and drain them.
Mix the ground beef, pork sausage meat, chopped onion and garlic (clove), egg and parsley.
Place some stuffing on each leaf and roll into parcels.
Arrange in a dish, add the chopped tomatoes, crumbled stock cube and 20 cl of water.
Cover and bake for 1 h 15.

saucisses-puree-oignons.title: Sausages, Mashed Potatoes and Caramelized Onions
steps: Cook the potatoes cut into pieces for 20 minutes in salted water, then mash them with the hot milk and half the butter. Add the ground nutmeg.
Slowly cook the sliced onions for 20 minutes over low heat with the remaining butter.
Brown the sausages in a frying pan for 15 minutes, turning them.
Serve the sausages on the mashed potatoes, with the onions.

boudin-noir-pommes.title: Blood Sausage with Apples and Mashed Potatoes
steps: Cook the potatoes for 20 minutes in salted water and mash them with the hot milk and 20 g of butter.
Brown the apples cut into quarters for 10 minutes with the remaining butter, then set aside.
Brown the blood sausage for 5 minutes on each side in the same pan.
Serve the blood sausage with the apples and mashed potatoes.

endives-jambon-gratinees.title: Gratinated Endives with Ham
steps: Cook the whole endives for 25 minutes in salted water, then press them well.
Prepare a béchamel: melt the butter, add the flour then the milk while whisking until thickened, with the ground nutmeg.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Roll each endive in a slice of cooked ham and arrange them in a dish.
Cover with béchamel, sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 25 minutes.

tomates-farcies-viande-riz.title: Stuffed Tomatoes with Rice
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Cut the tops off the tomatoes, hollow them out and keep the pulp.
Mix the ground beef, pork sausage meat, onion, garlic (clove) and parsley, all chopped, with the breadcrumbs.
Stuff the tomatoes and arrange them in a dish, with the pulp around and the raw rice in the juice.
Add 30 cl of water, put the tops back on and bake for 50 minutes.

courgettes-farcies-boeuf.title: Stuffed Zucchini with Beef
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Cut the zucchini in half and hollow them out.
Sauté the onion, garlic (clove), ground beef and chopped zucchini flesh in olive oil for 10 minutes. Add the Provençal herbs.
Stuff the zucchini and arrange them in a dish on top of the tomatoes.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 40 minutes.

pain-viande-tomate.title: Meatloaf with Tomato Sauce
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Mix the breadcrumbs and milk.
Add the ground beef, chopped onion, eggs, parsley and mustard, then season with salt and pepper.
Shape into a loaf in a loaf pan and bake for 50 minutes.
Heat the chopped tomatoes with Provençal herbs for 10 minutes, and serve in slices with the sauce.

boulettes-creme-champignons.title: Beef meatballs with cream and mushrooms
steps: Mix the ground beef, chopped onion, egg and breadcrumbs, then form meatballs.
Brown them for 10 minutes in a sauté pan with the olive oil, then set aside.
Sauté the sliced button mushrooms, add the single cream and return the meatballs for 10 minutes on low heat.
Cook the pasta according to the package instructions and serve with the meatballs.

escalopes-panees-puree.title: Breaded turkey escalopes and carrot mash
steps: Cook the carrots and potatoes in pieces for 20 minutes in salted water, then mash with the butter.
Coat the turkey escalopes in flour, beaten eggs, then breadcrumbs.
Brown them for 4 minutes on each side in a frying pan with olive oil.
Serve the escalopes with the mash.

poulet-riz-supreme.title: Chicken with rice and suprême sauce
steps: Place the chicken leg, carrots in rounds, onion and stock cube in a casserole, cover with water and simmer for 35 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Melt the butter, add the flour and sliced button mushrooms, then 30 cl of cooking stock while whisking.
Add the single cream, let thicken for 3 minutes and serve over the chicken and rice.

parmentier-canard-simple.title: Duck parmentier
steps: Place the duck leg in a saucepan with the onion, dried thyme and bay leaf, cover with water and simmer for 45 minutes. Drain and shred the meat without the skin.
Cook the potatoes for 20 minutes in salted water and mash with the hot milk and butter.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Place the duck in a dish and cover with the mash.
Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake for 25 minutes.

parmentier-potimarron-boeuf.title: Beef and red kuri squash parmentier
steps: Cook the red kuri squash and potatoes in pieces for 20 minutes in salted water, then mash with the milk and butter.
Sauté the sliced onion, chopped garlic (clove) and ground beef for 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Place the meat in a dish and cover with the mash.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 25 minutes.

pates-saucisse-brocoli.title: Pasta with pork sausage and broccoli
steps: Cook the pasta with the broccoli florets according to the package time.
Brown the crumbled pork sausage meat in a frying pan with olive oil and chopped garlic (clove), for 8 minutes.
Drain the pasta and broccoli, mix with the sausage.
Sprinkle with parmesan and serve.

tarte-jambon-comte.title: Ham and comté cheese tart
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and roll out the shortcrust pastry in a tart tin.
Arrange the cooked ham in pieces and comté cheese in cubes.
Beat the eggs with the single cream and ground nutmeg, pour over the filling.
Bake for 35 minutes, until the tart is golden.

cake-jambon-olives-salade.title: Ham and olive cake, green salad
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Mix the flour, baking powder, eggs, milk and 3 tablespoons of olive oil.
Add the cooked ham in cubes, olives and grated cheese, then pour into a loaf tin.
Bake for 45 minutes and let cool slightly.
Serve in slices with the green salad dressed with the remaining olive oil and vinegar.

parmentier-cabillaud.title: Cod parmentier
steps: Cook the potatoes for 20 minutes in salted water and mash with the hot milk and butter.
Poach the cod loin for 6 minutes in simmering water with the lemon juice, then flake it, removing any bones.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Mix the fish and chopped parsley in a dish, cover with the mash.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 20 minutes.

cabillaud-sauce-vierge.title: Cod with sauce vierge and steamed potatoes
steps: Cook the potatoes for 20 minutes in water or steam.
Dice the tomatoes and mix with chopped basil, lemon juice and 3 tablespoons of olive oil.
Cook the cod loin for 4 minutes on each side in a frying pan with the remaining olive oil.
Serve the fish with the potatoes and the sauce vierge.

cabillaud-lentilles-carottes.title: Cod with lentils and carrots
steps: Cook the rinsed lentils for 30 minutes in water with diced carrots, sliced onion, dried thyme and bay leaf.
Drain, remove the bay leaf, season with vinegar and 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Cook the cod loin for 4 minutes on each side in a frying pan with the remaining olive oil.
Serve the fish over the lentils.

papillotes-saumon-poireaux.title: Salmon en papillote with leeks
steps: Cook the potatoes for 20 minutes in salted water. Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Slice the leeks and sweat them for 5 minutes in a frying pan with a little water, then add the single cream.
Divide the leeks among 4 sheets of baking paper, place the salmon fillet and lemon juice on top, season with salt and pepper, and fold closed.
Bake for 15 minutes and serve with the potatoes.

truite-amandes-haricots-verts.title: Trout with almonds and green beans
steps: Cook the green beans for 10 minutes in salted water.
Lightly flour the trout fillets, then cook them for 3 minutes on each side in half the butter.
Brown the flaked almonds in the remaining butter and add the lemon juice.
Top the trout with the almonds and serve with the green beans.

maquereaux-moutarde-pommes-de-terre.title: Mackerel with mustard and potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Slice the potatoes, toss them with the oil and thyme, and bake for 20 minutes.
Spread mustard on the mackerel fillets.
Place them on top of the potatoes and bake for 10 minutes.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve.

colin-meuniere-epinards.title: Hake meunière with spinach
steps: Heat the frozen spinach in a pan with the chopped garlic for 10 minutes.
Lightly flour the hake fillets.
Cook them for 3 minutes on each side in the butter.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve with the spinach.

colin-sauce-tomate-olives.title: Hake with tomato and olives
steps: Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Sauté the sliced onion and chopped garlic in the oil, add the chopped tomatoes and Provençal herbs, and simmer for 10 minutes.
Place the hake in the sauce with the olives, cover, and cook for 10 minutes on low heat.
Serve with the rice.

colin-provencale-four.title: Oven-baked Provençal hake
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Slice the tomatoes and zucchini into thin rounds.
Arrange the vegetables in a baking dish, add the chopped garlic, Provençal herbs, and 2 tablespoons of oil, then bake for 15 minutes.
Place the hake on top, sprinkle with breadcrumbs, and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Bake for 15 minutes.

pain-thon-tomate.title: Tuna loaf with tomato
steps: Preheat the oven to 170 °C. Drain and flake the canned tuna.
Beat the eggs with the single cream, tomato paste, and Provençal herbs, add the tuna and breadcrumbs.
Pour into a loaf tin and bake for 45 minutes. Let cool.
Serve in slices with the green salad dressed with oil and vinegar.

tarte-thon-tomates-moutarde.title: Tuna, tomato and mustard tart
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line a tart tin with the shortcrust pastry.
Spread mustard over the base and scatter the flaked tuna.
Cover with sliced tomatoes, add Provençal herbs and grated cheese.
Bake for 35 minutes.

quiche-saumon-poireaux.title: Salmon and leek quiche
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line a tart tin with the shortcrust pastry.
Soften the sliced leeks for 10 minutes with the butter.
Cut the salmon into cubes and arrange with the leeks on the pastry.
Beat the eggs and single cream, pour over, and bake for 35 minutes.

blanquette-poisson-riz.title: Fish blanquette with rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Cook the carrots, leek pieces, and sliced button mushrooms for 15 minutes in 50 cl water with the stock cube.
Poach the fish, cut into pieces, for 5 minutes in this stock, then drain with the vegetables.
Melt the butter, add the flour, then 30 cl of the stock while whisking, and the single cream.
Add the lemon juice, fish, and vegetables, gently reheat, and serve with the rice.

cotriade-bretonne-simple.title: Cotriade, Breton fish soup
steps: Soften the sliced onion and leek in the butter at the bottom of a large pot.
Add the potatoes in pieces, 1.5 liters of water, dried thyme, and bay leaf, then cook for 20 minutes.
Add the fish in large pieces and simmer for 8 minutes without boiling.
Remove the bay leaf and serve the fish and potatoes in the broth.

chaudree-poisson-mais.title: Fish chowder with corn
steps: Sauté the bacon bits and sliced onion in a saucepan.
Add the diced potatoes, milk, 30 cl water, and dried thyme, then cook for 15 minutes.
Add the hake in pieces, drained canned corn, and single cream.
Simmer for 6 minutes and serve.

gratin-crevettes-poireaux.title: Shrimp and leek gratin
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Soften the sliced leeks for 10 minutes with a little butter.
Prepare a béchamel with the remaining butter, flour, and milk, then add the ground nutmeg.
Mix the leeks and thawed peeled shrimp in a dish, cover with the béchamel.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 20 minutes.

haddock-poche-epinards.title: Poached smoked haddock, spinach and potatoes
steps: Cook the potatoes in water for 20 minutes.
Heat the frozen spinach with the butter for 8 minutes.
Bring the milk and bay leaf to a simmer, poach the smoked haddock for 8 minutes without boiling.
Drain the smoked haddock and serve with the spinach and potatoes. Add pepper.

parmentier-saumon-epinards.title: Salmon and spinach cottage pie
steps: Cook the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes and mash with the hot milk, butter and ground nutmeg.
Heat the frozen spinach for 8 minutes and drain.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Place the diced salmon and spinach in a baking dish, cover with the mash.
Bake for 25 minutes.

crumble-cabillaud-parmesan.title: Cod and parmesan crumble
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Slice the leeks and cut the carrots into thin rounds, cook them in a pan with a little water for 10 minutes.
Place the vegetables in a baking dish with the single cream and the cod loin cut into pieces.
Rub the flour, butter and parmesan together with your fingertips.
Sprinkle the crumble over the fish and bake for 20 minutes.

tian-sardines-pommes-de-terre.title: Sardine and potato tian
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Cut the potatoes, tomatoes and onion into thin slices.
Layer them in a baking dish with the chopped garlic, Provençal herbs and olive oil.
Bake for 35 minutes.
Add the drained canned sardines and bake for another 10 minutes.

saumon-lentilles-moutarde.title: Salmon with lentils and mustard sauce
steps: Cook the rinsed lentils for 30 minutes with the dried thyme, then drain.
Soften the sliced shallots, add the single cream and mustard.
Cook the salmon fillet for 4 minutes on each side in a pan.
Serve the salmon on the lentils and top with the sauce.

croquettes-thon-pommes-de-terre.title: Tuna and potato croquettes
steps: Cook the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes and mash them.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Mix the mash, crumbled canned tuna, 1 egg and chopped parsley.
Shape into croquettes, dip them in the other beaten egg then in the breadcrumbs.
Place them on a baking tray, drizzle with 2 spoons of olive oil and bake for 15 minutes.
Serve with lemon and the green salad dressed with the remaining olive oil and vinegar.

pissaladiere-salade.title: Pissaladière and green salad
steps: Mix the flour, dried baker's yeast, 2 spoons of olive oil, 15 cl water and salt, then leave to rest for 20 minutes.
Soften the sliced onions for 30 minutes over low heat with 3 spoons of olive oil and dried thyme.
Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Roll out the dough, cover with onions, arrange the anchovy fillets and olives.
Bake for 20 minutes and serve with the green salad dressed with the remaining olive oil and vinegar.

salade-nicoise-chaude-thon.title: Potatoes, green beans and tuna Niçoise-style
steps: Cook the potatoes in salted water for 20 minutes, the green beans for 10 minutes and the eggs for 9 minutes.
Cut the potatoes and tomatoes into pieces, peel the eggs.
Mix the olive oil, vinegar and mustard.
Arrange everything with the crumbled canned tuna and olives, then drizzle with the vinaigrette.

gratin-dauphinois-salade.title: Gratin dauphinois and green salad
steps: Preheat the oven to 160 °C. Cut the potatoes into thin slices without rinsing them.
Rub a buttered dish with the garlic (clove), layer the potatoes with salt, pepper and ground nutmeg.
Pour in the milk and single cream, then bake for 1 h 15.
Serve with the green salad dressed with olive oil and vinegar.

gratin-savoyard-comte.title: Savoyard gratin with Comté cheese
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Cut the potatoes into thin slices and slice the onions.
In a buttered dish, alternate layers of potatoes, onions and grated Comté cheese, with a little ground nutmeg.
Pour in 40 cl hot water with the stock cube.
Bake for 1 h, until the top is golden.

gratin-butternut-creme.title: Butternut squash gratin with cream
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Peel the butternut squash and cut into thin slices.
Arrange them in a dish rubbed with garlic (clove), pour over the single cream with ground nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 45 minutes.

gratin-brocoli-pates.title: Pasta and broccoli gratin
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cook the pasta and broccoli florets together according to the packet.
Make a béchamel: melt the butter, add the flour then the milk while whisking, with ground nutmeg and half the grated cheese.
Mix everything in a baking dish and sprinkle with the remaining cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes.

gratin-poireaux-jambon.title: Leek and Cooked Ham Gratin
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cook the leeks cut into pieces for 15 minutes in salted water and drain well.
Prepare a béchamel sauce with the butter, flour and milk, add the nutmeg.
Arrange the leeks and ham cut into pieces in a dish, cover with the béchamel.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 25 minutes.

tian-legumes-provencal.title: Provençal Vegetable Tian with Rice
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Soften the sliced onion and chopped garlic in 1 spoonful of olive oil at the bottom of a dish.
Slice the vegetables into thin rounds and arrange them upright, alternating them.
Add the Provençal herbs and the rest of the olive oil, season with salt and pepper.
Bake for 50 minutes, covering halfway through. Serve with rice cooked according to the package.

parmigiana-aubergines.title: Eggplant Parmesan Gratin
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Slice the eggplants, brush with olive oil and roast for 20 minutes on a baking tray.
Simmer the chopped tomatoes with the chopped garlic for 15 minutes, then add the basil.
Layer in a dish the sauce, eggplants, mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake for 30 minutes at 180 °C and let rest for 10 minutes.

gratin-epinards-oeufs.title: Spinach and Egg Gratin
steps: Cook the eggs for 9 minutes, peel and cut them in half. Heat the frozen spinach and drain well.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Prepare a béchamel sauce with the butter, flour and milk, add the nutmeg.
Mix the spinach and half the béchamel in a dish, place the eggs on top, cover with the rest.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 15 minutes.

gratin-panais-carottes.title: Parsnip and Carrot Gratin
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Slice the vegetables into thin rounds and steam for 10 minutes.
Arrange them in a dish rubbed with garlic, with the dried thyme.
Pour over the single cream, sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 35 minutes.

gratin-pommes-de-terre-champignons.title: Potato and Button Mushroom Gratin
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Sauté the sliced onion and button mushrooms with the butter and chopped garlic.
Slice the potatoes into thin rounds.
Alternate layers of potatoes and mushrooms in a dish, add the dried thyme and pour over the single cream with 10 cl water.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 55 minutes.

quiche-poireaux-chevre.title: Leek and Goat Cheese Quiche
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and roll out the shortcrust pastry in a tin.
Soften the sliced leeks for 10 minutes with the butter.
Spread the leeks and goat cheese cut into pieces over the pastry.
Beat the eggs and single cream, pour over and bake for 35 minutes.

tarte-oignons-alsacienne.title: Onion Tart
steps: Soften the sliced onions for 25 minutes over low heat with the butter, without browning.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C and roll out the shortcrust pastry in a tin.
Beat the eggs, single cream and nutmeg, add the onions and pour over the pastry.
Bake for 30 minutes.

tarte-courgettes-feta.title: Zucchini and Feta Tart
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C and roll out the shortcrust pastry in a tin.
Slice the zucchinis into thin rounds and brown them for 8 minutes in a frying pan.
Spread them over the pastry with crumbled feta and chopped mint.
Beat the eggs and single cream, pour over and bake for 30 minutes.

flamiche-poireaux.title: Leek Flamiche
steps: Soften the sliced leeks for 15 minutes with the butter. Off the heat, add 1 egg and the single cream.
Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Roll out one puff pastry sheet on a tray and spread the leeks on top, leaving the edge free.
Cover with the second pastry sheet, seal the edges and brush with the second beaten egg.
Bake for 35 minutes.

tourte-epinards-ricotta.title: Spinach and Ricotta Pie
steps: Heat the frozen spinach and squeeze well.
Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Mix the spinach, ricotta, 1 egg, parmesan and nutmeg.
Spread over one puff pastry sheet, cover with the second, seal and brush with the second beaten egg.
Bake for 40 minutes.

lentilles-vigneronnes-oeuf.title: Wine-Braised Lentils with Soft-Boiled Egg
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and diced carrots in olive oil.
Add the rinsed lentils, red wine, dried thyme, bay leaf and 60 cl water, then cook for 35 minutes.
Cook the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel them.
Remove the bay leaf, serve the lentils with an egg on each plate.

flageolets-tomates-herbes.title: Flageolet beans with tomato and herbs
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and chopped garlic in the oil.
Add the chopped tomatoes and dried thyme, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the drained flageolet beans and cook for 10 minutes.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve.

tomates-farcies-riz-feta.title: Tomatoes stuffed with rice and feta
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Cook the rice for 10 minutes in salted water and drain.
Cut the tops off the tomatoes, scoop them out and chop the pulp.
Mix the rice, feta, chopped herbs, tomato pulp and 2 tablespoons of olive oil, then stuff the tomatoes.
Drizzle with the remaining oil and bake for 35 minutes.

courgettes-farcies-quinoa-chevre.title: Zucchini stuffed with quinoa and goat cheese
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Cook the quinoa according to the package instructions.
Cut the zucchinis in half, scoop them out and chop the flesh.
Sauté the onion, zucchini flesh and diced tomato in the oil, add the quinoa and Provençal herbs.
Stuff the zucchinis, add the goat cheese and bake for 30 minutes.

aubergines-farcies-tomate-mozzarella.title: Eggplants stuffed with tomato and mozzarella
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Cut the eggplants in half, score the flesh, brush with oil and roast for 25 minutes.
Scoop out the flesh and sauté it with the onion and chopped garlic, add the chopped tomatoes and Provençal herbs.
Simmer for 10 minutes, then stuff the eggplants.
Top with mozzarella and bake for 15 minutes.

champignons-farcis-riz.title: Stuffed button mushrooms and herbed rice
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Separate the mushroom stems and chop them with the garlic, parsley and shallots.
Sauté this mixture for 5 minutes with the butter and add the breadcrumbs.
Stuff the mushroom caps and bake for 20 minutes.

galettes-sarrasin-champignons-oeuf.title: Buckwheat galettes with mushrooms and egg
steps: Mix the buckwheat flour, salt and 45 cl water, then let rest for 20 minutes.
Sauté the shallots and sliced button mushrooms with a little butter.
Cook a galette in a buttered pan, crack an egg in the center, add the mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes.
Fold the edges and serve. Repeat for the remaining galettes.

souffle-fromage-salade.title: Cheese soufflé and green salad
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C and butter a soufflé dish. Prepare a thick béchamel with the butter, flour and milk.
Separate the egg whites from the yolks. Off the heat, add the yolks to the béchamel, along with the grated Comté cheese and ground nutmeg.
Whisk the egg whites until stiff and gently fold them in.
Pour into the dish and bake for 30 minutes without opening the oven door.
Serve immediately with the green salad dressed with olive oil and vinegar.

oeufs-cocotte-epinards-creme.title: Baked eggs with spinach and soldiers
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Heat the frozen spinach with the nutmeg and drain.
Divide the spinach and single cream among 4 small dishes, crack 2 eggs into each.
Bake in a water bath in the oven for 12 minutes.
Serve with the baguette cut into soldiers.

omelette-fines-herbes-salade.title: Herb omelette with sautéed potatoes
steps: Cut the potatoes into cubes and brown for 20 minutes in 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Beat the eggs with the chopped herbs, salt and pepper.
Cook the omelette for 4 minutes with the butter.
Serve with the potatoes and the green salad dressed with the remaining oil and vinegar.

crepes-epinards-ricotta.title: Baked crêpes with spinach and ricotta
steps: Mix the flour, eggs and milk, then cook 8 crêpes in a buttered pan.
Heat the frozen spinach, squeeze out the liquid and mix with the ricotta and nutmeg.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Fill and roll the crêpes, arrange them in a baking dish.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 15 minutes.

pates-champignons-creme.title: Pasta with mushrooms and cream
steps: Cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
Sauté the shallots and sliced button mushrooms with the butter for 8 minutes.
Add the single cream and parmesan, let thicken for 2 minutes.
Mix with the pasta and sprinkle with parsley.

polenta-champignons-comte.title: Creamy polenta with mushrooms
steps: Sauté the sliced button mushrooms with the butter and chopped garlic for 10 minutes.
Bring the milk and 60 cl water to a boil, pour in the polenta and stir for 5 minutes.
Add the grated Comté cheese and salt.
Serve the polenta with the mushrooms and chopped parsley.

polenta-gratinee-tomate.title: Polenta gratin with tomato
steps: Bring 1.2 liters of salted water to a boil, pour in the polenta gradually, stir for 5 minutes and spread in a dish. Let set for 15 minutes.
Sauté the sliced onion and chopped garlic in the oil, add the chopped tomatoes and Provençal herbs, and cook for 10 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cover the polenta with the sauce and mozzarella.
Bake for 15 minutes.

risotto-butternut.title: Butternut squash risotto
steps: Heat 1.2 liters of water with the stock cube.
Sauté the sliced onion and diced butternut squash in the butter for 5 minutes.
Add the rice and toast for 2 minutes, then pour in the stock one ladle at a time, stirring for 20 minutes.
Off the heat, add the parmesan and serve.

haricots-blancs-tomate-oeufs.title: White beans with tomato and eggs
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and chopped garlic in the oil with the paprika.
Add the chopped tomatoes and drained canned white beans, then simmer for 12 minutes.
Make 4 wells, break an egg into each, cover and cook for 6 minutes.

parmentier-lentilles-carottes.title: Lentil and carrot cottage pie
steps: Cook the rinsed lentils for 30 minutes with the diced carrots, sliced onion, dried thyme and tomato paste.
Cook the potatoes for 20 minutes in salted water and mash with the hot milk and butter.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Place the lentils in a dish and cover with the mash.
Bake for 20 minutes.

bourguignon-champignons-lentilles.title: Mushroom and lentil bourguignon
steps: Brown the quartered button mushrooms in a Dutch oven with the oil, then set aside.
Sauté the sliced onion, carrot rounds and chopped garlic. Sprinkle with flour.
Add the red wine, tomato paste, lentils, dried thyme, bay leaf and 50 cl of water.
Cover and simmer for 40 minutes.
Return the mushrooms, cook for 10 minutes and remove the bay leaf.

pot-au-feu-legumes-bouillon.title: Vegetable and chickpea pot-au-feu
steps: Bring 2 liters of water to a boil with the stock cube, dried thyme and bay leaf.
Add the carrots, turnips and leeks cut into pieces, then cook for 20 minutes.
Add the white cabbage in wedges and the potatoes, then cook for 20 minutes.
Add the drained chickpeas, reheat for 5 minutes, remove the bay leaf and serve with mustard.

clafoutis-courgettes-chevre.title: Zucchini and goat cheese clafoutis
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Brown the zucchini rounds in the oil for 8 minutes.
Beat the eggs, flour and milk, add the chopped mint.
Arrange the zucchini and goat cheese in a dish, pour in the batter.
Bake for 30 minutes.

chou-rouge-pommes-pommes-de-terre.title: Red cabbage with apples and potatoes
steps: Slice the red cabbage and onion, dice the apples.
Sauté the onion in the oil, add the cabbage, apples, vinegar, sugar and 20 cl of water.
Cover and simmer for 50 minutes on low heat.
Cook the potatoes for 20 minutes in salted water and serve with the cabbage.

choux-bruxelles-gratines-pommes-de-terre.title: Gratinated Brussels sprouts and potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cook the Brussels sprouts for 10 minutes and the potato rounds for 12 minutes in salted water.
Drain them and place in a dish.
Pour over the single cream with ground nutmeg, sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 20 minutes.

fenouil-gratine-parmesan-riz.title: Parmesan fennel gratin with rice
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cook the fennel wedges for 15 minutes in salted water and drain.
Cook the rice according to the package.
Place the fennel in an oiled dish, pour over the single cream, sprinkle with parmesan and bake for 20 minutes.

soupe-pistou.title: Pistou soup
steps: Cut all the vegetables into small cubes.
Put them in 2 liters of water, except the canned white beans, and cook for 30 minutes.
Add the drained canned white beans and pasta, then cook for 10 minutes.
Blend the basil, garlic, parmesan and olive oil to make the pistou.
Add the pistou off the heat and serve.

garbure-bearnaise-simple.title: Simplified Béarnaise garbure
steps: Put the duck leg in a large pot with 2.5 liters of water, garlic, dried thyme and bay leaf, then simmer for 45 minutes.
Add the sliced savoy cabbage, carrots, turnips and leeks cut into pieces, then cook for 30 minutes.
Add the potatoes and drained canned white beans, then cook for 20 minutes.
Shred the duck, return it to the soup and remove the bay leaf.

soupe-oignon-gratinee.title: Gratinated Onion Soup
steps: Melt the sliced onions for 25 minutes over low heat with the butter until golden.
Sprinkle with flour, add 1.5 litres of water with the stock cube and simmer for 15 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Divide into ovenproof bowls and place the slices of baguette on top.
Sprinkle with grated Comté cheese and bake for 10 minutes.

soupe-pois-casses-lardons.title: Split Pea Soup with Bacon Bits
steps: Rinse the split peas. Sauté the bacon bits and sliced onion in a pot.
Add the peas, carrots and leek in rounds, the thyme, bay leaf and 2 litres of water.
Simmer for 50 minutes.
Remove the bay leaf and blend part of the soup. Taste before adding salt.

soupe-paysanne-lardons-pain.title: Country Soup with Bacon Bits
steps: Sauté the bacon bits in a pot.
Add the diced vegetables, thyme and 2 litres of water.
Simmer for 35 minutes and taste before adding salt.
Toast the country bread, cover with grated cheese and serve on the soup.

soupe-haricots-blancs-chou.title: White Bean Soup with Cabbage
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and chopped garlic in olive oil.
Add the diced carrots, sliced white cabbage, chopped tomatoes, thyme, 1.5 litres of water and the stock cube.
Simmer for 30 minutes.
Add the drained canned white beans, cook for 5 minutes and serve.

soupe-butternut-lentilles-corail.title: Butternut Squash Soup with Red Lentils
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and grated fresh ginger in olive oil with cumin.
Add the diced butternut squash, rinsed red lentils and 1 litre of water, then cook for 20 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and blend.

veloute-cresson-oeuf-mollet.title: Watercress Velouté with Soft-Boiled Egg
steps: Soften the sliced onion in butter, add the diced potatoes, 1 litre of water and the stock cube, then cook for 20 minutes.
Add the watercress, cook for 3 minutes and blend with the single cream.
Cook the eggs for 6 minutes, cool them and peel.
Serve the velouté with one egg in each bowl and the baguette.

soupe-poulet-riz-citron.title: Chicken Soup with Rice and Lemon
steps: Place the chicken leg in 2 litres of water with the stock cube and simmer for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken, add the carrots and leek in rounds, and the rice, then cook for 15 minutes.
Shred the chicken and return it to the soup.
Add the lemon juice and chopped parsley.

soupe-boeuf-legumes-pates.title: Beef Soup with Vegetables and Small Pasta
steps: Place the beef for braising in cubes in 2.5 litres of water with the onion, stock cube, thyme and bay leaf. Bring to a boil and skim.
Simmer for 1 h 15.
Add the diced vegetables and cook for 30 minutes.
Add the pasta, cook according to the package and remove the bay leaf.

potage-poireaux-haddock.title: Leek and Smoked Haddock Soup
steps: Cook the sliced leeks and diced potatoes for 20 minutes in 70 cl of water.
Add the milk and smoked haddock, then poach for 8 minutes without boiling.
Remove the haddock and flake it.
Blend the soup with the single cream, add the fish and pepper. Taste before adding salt.

soupe-pois-chiches-pates.title: Chickpea Soup with Small Pasta
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and chopped garlic in olive oil.
Add the chopped tomatoes, drained chickpeas, Provençal herbs, stock cube and 1.2 litres of water, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook according to the package.

veloute-chou-fleur-lardons.title: Cauliflower Velouté with Bacon Bits and Croutons
steps: Cook the cauliflower florets, potatoes and onion for 20 minutes in 80 cl of water.
Add the milk and blend. Taste before adding salt.
Brown the bacon bits in a pan, then toast the diced baguette in their fat.
Serve the velouté with the bacon bits and croutons.

soupe-potimarron-tartines-chevre.title: Red Kuri Squash Soup with Goat Cheese Toasts
steps: Cut the red kuri squash into pieces, keeping the well-washed skin. Cook with the onion for 25 minutes in 1 litre of water.
Blend with the single cream and ground nutmeg.
Toast the country bread, spread with goat cheese and grill for 3 minutes under the oven broiler.
Serve the soup with the toasts.

soupe-lentilles-corail-epinards-citron.title: Red lentil, spinach and lemon soup
steps: Sauté the sliced onion in oil with cumin and turmeric.
Add the rinsed red lentils, chopped tomatoes and 1 litre of water, then cook for 15 minutes.
Add the frozen spinach and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the lemon juice, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

soupe-legumes-vermicelles-poulet.title: Vegetable soup with rice vermicelli and chicken
steps: Bring 1.8 litres of water to a boil with the stock cube.
Add the diced vegetables and the whole chicken fillet, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Remove the chicken, shred it and return it to the soup.
Add the rice vermicelli, cook for 3 minutes and sprinkle with parsley.

potage-tomate-riz-oeuf-poche.title: Tomato soup with rice and poached egg
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and chopped garlic (clove) in oil, add the chopped tomatoes, Provençal herbs and 80 cl of water.
Add the rice and simmer for 15 minutes.
Poach the eggs for 3 minutes in simmering water with vinegar.
Serve the soup with an egg in each bowl.

soupe-fenouil-tomate-cabillaud.title: Tomato soup with fennel and cod loin
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and fennel in oil, add the chopped garlic (clove).
Add the chopped tomatoes, diced potatoes and 70 cl of water, then simmer for 20 minutes.
