Add the cod loin in pieces and cook for 6 minutes on low heat.

boeuf-miroton-oignons.title: Beef miroton with onions
steps: Cut the beef for braising into cubes and brown in a casserole with oil, then set aside.
Soften the sliced onions for 10 minutes, sprinkle with flour and add the vinegar.
Return the beef with tomato paste, stock cube, bay leaf and 50 cl of water, cover and simmer for 1 h 30.
Add the potatoes in pieces and cook for 25 minutes. Remove the bay leaf.

gratin-colin-chou-fleur.title: Hake and cauliflower gratin
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cook the cauliflower florets for 12 minutes in salted water and drain.
Prepare a béchamel with butter, flour and milk, add ground nutmeg.
Arrange the cauliflower and hake fillet pieces in a dish, cover with béchamel.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 20 minutes.

gratin-riz-courgettes-tomates.title: Rice gratin with zucchini and tomatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Cook the rice for 10 minutes in salted water and drain.
Sauté the sliced onion, chopped garlic (clove) and diced zucchini in oil for 10 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes and Provençal herbs, then mix with the rice in a dish.
Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake for 25 minutes.

tajine-poulet-citron-olives.title: Chicken tagine with lemon and olives
steps: Brown the chicken legs in oil with the sliced onion, crushed garlic (clove), grated fresh ginger and turmeric.
Pour in 30 cl of water, season with salt and pepper, cover and simmer for 25 minutes.
Add the potatoes in wedges and the lemon in thin slices, then cook covered for another 25 minutes.
Add the olives and chopped fresh coriander, reduce the sauce uncovered and serve.

couscous-legumes-pois-chiches.title: Vegetable couscous with chickpeas
steps: Sauté the sliced onion in 2 tablespoons of oil with ras el hanout.
Add the carrots in pieces, chopped tomatoes, 1 litre of water and salt, then cook for 20 minutes.
Add the zucchini in pieces and drained chickpeas, then cook for another 15 minutes.
Pour the same volume of boiling salted water with the remaining oil over the semolina, cover for 5 minutes, fluff with a fork and serve with the vegetables and their broth.

harira-agneau-lentilles.title: Harira with lamb and lentils
steps: Brown the lamb shoulder in small pieces with the sliced onion in oil, then add grated fresh ginger, turmeric and cinnamon.
Add the chopped tomatoes, rinsed lentils, 1.5 litres of water and salt, cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
Add the drained chickpeas, chopped fresh coriander and parsley, then cook for another 10 minutes.
Dissolve the cornstarch in a little cold water, pour in while stirring and let thicken for 2 minutes.
Serve hot with a squeeze of lemon juice.

loubia-haricots-blancs-tomate.title: Loubia, stewed white beans with tomato
steps: Sauté the sliced onion and crushed garlic (clove) in oil.
Add paprika, cumin, chili, chopped tomatoes, 20 cl of water and salt, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the drained and rinsed canned white beans and cook for another 10 minutes on low heat.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve.

tajine-boeuf-abricots-amandes.title: Beef tagine with dried apricots and flaked almonds
steps: Brown the beef for braising in large cubes in oil with the sliced onion, grated fresh ginger and cinnamon.
Cover with water to the level of the meat, season with salt, cover and simmer for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Add the dried apricots and honey, then cook uncovered for 20 minutes.
Toast the flaked almonds in a dry pan.
Soak the semolina with the same volume of boiling salted water, then serve the tagine sprinkled with almonds.

pastilla-poulet-amandes.title: Chicken and Almond Pastilla
steps: Cook the chicken with the sliced onion, fresh ginger, turmeric, salt and 30 cl water for 20 minutes, then shred the meat.
Reduce the cooking juices, cook the beaten eggs in it while stirring like scrambled eggs, then add the chicken and chopped fresh coriander.
Toast the ground almonds in a dry pan, then mix with the sugar and cinnamon, keeping 1 spoonful of this mixture aside.
Preheat the oven to 180 °C, melt the butter and line a round tin with 6 buttered brick pastry sheets, letting them hang over the edges.
Spread the almond mixture, then the filling, fold over the sheets, cover with the last 2 buttered sheets.
Bake for 25 minutes until the pastilla is golden and sprinkle with the reserved mixture.

colin-chermoula-pommes-de-terre.title: Hake with Chermoula and Potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and blend the fresh coriander, garlic (clove), paprika, cumin, lemon juice, olive oil and salt.
Mix the potatoes sliced thinly with half of this chermoula in a dish and bake for 25 minutes.
Add the tomatoes in wedges and the fish, spoon over the rest of the chermoula.
Bake for 15 minutes, until the fish flakes easily.

mujaddara-lentilles-riz-oignons.title: Mujaddara, Lentils and Rice with Caramelized Onions
steps: Cook the rinsed lentils for 15 minutes in 80 cl water.
Slowly brown the sliced onion in olive oil over medium heat for 20 minutes, until very brown.
Add the rice, cumin, salt and pepper to the lentils and their water, topping up with water if needed, cover and cook for 15 minutes on low heat.
Let rest covered then serve topped with the onions.

chich-taouk-poulet-riz.title: Chich Taouk, Lebanese Marinated Chicken and Rice
steps: Mix the plain yogurt, lemon juice, crushed garlic (clove), tomato paste, paprika, 1 spoon of olive oil and salt.
Cut the chicken fillet into cubes, coat with this marinade and chill for 30 minutes.
Cook the rice.
Sear the chicken in the remaining oil over high heat for 10 minutes, turning, until well cooked and golden.
Serve with the rice.

colin-sauce-tahini-riz.title: Baked Hake, Lemon Tahini Sauce and Rice
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and cook the rice.
Place the hake fillet in a dish, drizzle with olive oil, salt, sprinkle with cumin and bake for 15 minutes.
Mix the sesame paste, lemon juice, crushed garlic (clove) and 10 cl water until smooth.
Coat the fish with the sauce, bake for another 5 minutes and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve with the rice.

maghmour-aubergines-pois-chiches.title: Maghmour, Eggplant and Chickpeas in Tomato Sauce
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C, cut the eggplant into cubes, toss with 3 spoons of olive oil and bake for 25 minutes.
Sauté the sliced onion and crushed garlic (clove) in the remaining oil with cumin and chili.
Add the chopped tomatoes, drained chickpeas, eggplant and salt, then simmer for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle with chopped mint and serve hot or warm.

palak-tofu-epinards-riz.title: Palak with Tofu, Spiced Spinach and Rice
steps: Cook the rice and brown the firm tofu in cubes in 1 spoon of sunflower oil, then set aside.
Sauté the sliced onion, garlic (clove) and grated fresh ginger in the remaining sunflower oil with the spices.
Add the frozen spinach and salt and cook for 10 minutes.
Blend with the coconut milk, add the tofu and reheat for 5 minutes before serving with the rice.

aloo-gobi-chou-fleur-pommes-de-terre.title: Aloo Gobi, Cauliflower and Potatoes with Spices
steps: Sauté the sliced onion in sunflower oil with cumin, then add garlic (clove) and grated fresh ginger.
Add turmeric, garam masala, potatoes in cubes and cauliflower in florets.
Add diced tomatoes, salt and 15 cl water, cover and cook for 25 minutes on low heat.
Sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander and serve.

biryani-poulet-epices.title: Chicken Biryani with Spices
steps: Mix the chicken fillet in pieces with plain yogurt, crushed garlic (clove), grated fresh ginger, spices and half the salt, then chill for 20 minutes.
Brown the sliced onion in sunflower oil, keep half aside, then sear the chicken in the pan for 10 minutes.
Cook the rice for 6 minutes in a large pot of salted water and drain, it should remain firm.
Spread the rice over the chicken with raisins, chopped fresh coriander and mint and 10 cl water.
Cover tightly and cook on very low heat for 20 minutes, then serve with the reserved onion.

poulet-korma-amandes.title: Chicken Korma with Almonds
steps: Cook the rice and sauté the sliced onion in sunflower oil with garlic (clove) and grated fresh ginger.
Add the chicken fillet in pieces and the spices, then brown for 5 minutes.
Add ground almonds, 20 cl water and salt, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the plain yogurt and single cream, reheat gently without boiling and serve with the rice.

keema-boeuf-petits-pois.title: Keema, Ground Beef with Peas and Spices
steps: Cook the rice and sauté the sliced onion in sunflower oil with garlic (clove) and grated fresh ginger.
Add the ground beef and spices and cook until the meat is well browned.
Add chopped tomatoes and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the frozen peas, cook for 5 more minutes and serve with the rice.

crevettes-masala-tomate-riz.title: Shrimp Masala with Tomato and Rice
steps: Cook the rice and thaw the peeled shrimp, then drain well.
Sauté the sliced onion in sunflower oil with garlic (clove), grated fresh ginger and spices.
Add chopped tomatoes, coconut milk and salt, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the shrimp, cook for 5 minutes, sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander and serve with the rice.

pad-thai-crevettes.title: Shrimp Pad Thai
steps: Soak the rice vermicelli in hot water according to the package instructions, then drain.
Mix the tamari, nuoc mam, sugar, and the juice of one lime.
Sear the peeled shrimp and crushed garlic in the oil over high heat, then push to the side and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice vermicelli and sauce, mix for 3 minutes, then add the mung bean sprouts and sliced spring onion.
Serve with crushed peanuts and the other lime cut into wedges.

bibimbap-boeuf-legumes.title: Beef and Vegetable Bibimbap
steps: Cook the rice and cut the beef rump steak into thin strips, then mix with soy sauce, sugar, and crushed garlic.
Sauté separately in a little sesame oil the carrot sticks, sliced button mushrooms, then the fresh spinach.
Sear the beef for 2 minutes over high heat.
Fry the eggs.
Divide the rice into bowls, arrange the vegetables, beef, and egg, then sprinkle with sesame seeds and chili.

porc-caramel-vietnamien-oeufs.title: Vietnamese Caramel Pork with Eggs
steps: Cook the eggs for 9 minutes, peel them, and cook the rice.
Melt the sugar dry in a pot until you get an amber caramel, then carefully pour in 30 cl hot water.
Brown the pork tenderloin cubes in oil with sliced shallot and crushed garlic, then add the caramel and nuoc mam.
Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes, add the eggs and cook for another 5 minutes until the sauce is syrupy.
Add pepper and serve with the rice.

poulet-gong-bao-cacahuetes.title: Gong Bao Chicken with Peanuts
steps: Cook the rice and mix the diced chicken fillet with cornstarch and 1 spoonful of soy sauce.
Mix the rest of the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and 5 cl water.
Sear the chicken over high heat in oil for 5 minutes, then set aside.
Sauté the diced bell pepper, garlic, grated fresh ginger, and chili for 3 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the sauce, peanuts, and sliced spring onion, then serve with the rice.

mapo-tofu-boeuf.title: Mapo Tofu with Beef
steps: Cook the rice and cut the firm tofu into cubes.
Brown the ground beef in oil with crushed garlic, grated fresh ginger, and chili.
Add the soy sauce and 25 cl water, then the tofu, and simmer for 5 minutes.
Dissolve the cornstarch in a little cold water, pour in while stirring gently, and sprinkle with sliced spring onion before serving with the rice.

riz-saute-ananas-crevettes.title: Thai Fried Rice with Pineapple and Shrimp
steps: Cook the rice, spread it on a tray, and let it cool.
Sear the peeled shrimp in oil over high heat, then push to the side and scramble the eggs.
Add the rice, curry, tamari, and nuoc mam and stir-fry for 5 minutes.
Add the pineapple cut into small pieces, frozen peas, and sliced spring onion, cook for another 3 minutes, and serve immediately.

okonomiyaki-chou.title: Okonomiyaki, Japanese Cabbage Pancake
steps: Finely slice the white cabbage and spring onion.
Whisk the flour, eggs, and 12 cl water, then add the cabbage and spring onion.
Cook 2 large pancakes in oil over medium heat, 6 minutes on each side, covered.
Drizzle with soy sauce, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve immediately.

rendang-boeuf-coco.title: Beef Rendang with Coconut Milk
steps: Blend the onion, garlic, fresh ginger, turmeric, chili, and cinnamon into a paste.
Sauté this paste for 5 minutes in oil, then brown the beef for braising cut into cubes.
Toast the grated coconut dry, then add it with the coconut milk, 20 cl water, and salt.
Simmer uncovered for 2 hours over low heat, stirring occasionally, until the sauce is almost absorbed.
Drizzle with lime juice and serve with the rice.

saute-boeuf-brocoli.title: Beef Stir-Fry with Broccoli
steps: Cook the rice and blanch the broccoli florets for 3 minutes in boiling water.
Cut the beef rump steak into thin strips and mix with cornstarch and 1 spoonful of soy sauce.
Sear the beef for 2 minutes over high heat in oil with garlic and grated fresh ginger.
Add the broccoli, the rest of the soy sauce, sugar, and 5 cl water, mix for 2 minutes, and serve with the rice.

tinga-poulet-tostadas.title: Chicken Tinga on Tostadas
steps: Poach the chicken fillet for 15 minutes in simmering salted water, then shred.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C and bake the tortilla wraps for 6 minutes until crispy.
Sauté the sliced onion and garlic in oil, add paprika, chili, and chopped tomatoes, then cook for 10 minutes.
Add the chicken and mix for 3 minutes.
Top the tostadas with tinga, avocado slices, and a little thick crème fraîche.

enchiladas-haricots-rouges-four.title: Baked Enchiladas with Red Beans
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and sauté the sliced onion and garlic in oil with cumin and paprika.
Add the chopped tomatoes and salt, cook for 10 minutes, then mix a third of this sauce with the red beans and drained canned corn.
Fill and roll the tortilla wraps, then pack them tightly in a dish.
Cover with the rest of the sauce, top with grated cheese, and bake for 20 minutes.

bol-burrito-riz-haricots-avocat.title: Burrito Bowl with Rice, Beans, and Avocado
steps: Cook the rice, then season with the juice of one lime and chopped fresh coriander.
Sauté the chopped onion in oil, add cumin, drained red beans, and 5 cl water, then reheat for 5 minutes.
Cut the tomatoes and avocados into cubes and drizzle with the juice of the other lime.
Divide the rice into bowls with the beans, drained canned corn, tomatoes, and avocado, season with salt, and serve.

arroz-rojo-poulet.title: Arroz rojo with chicken
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a Dutch oven, then set aside.
Sauté the sliced onion, garlic and rice for 3 minutes in the same Dutch oven.
Add the chopped tomatoes, spices, salt, diced carrots, 50 cl water and the chicken.
Cover and cook for 25 minutes on low heat, adding a little water if needed.
Add the frozen peas, cook for another 5 minutes and serve.

pasta-alla-norma-aubergines-ricotta.title: Pasta alla norma with eggplant and ricotta
steps: Cut the eggplants into cubes and brown for 15 minutes in 3 tablespoons of olive oil.
Sauté the garlic in the remaining olive oil, add the chopped tomatoes and salt, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Cook the pasta and add the eggplant to the sauce.
Mix the pasta and sauce and serve topped with crumbled ricotta and basil.

pasta-e-fagioli-haricots-blancs.title: Pasta e fagioli with white beans
steps: Sauté the onion and diced carrot in olive oil with the crushed garlic.
Add the chopped tomatoes, oregano, salt and 1 litre water, then cook for 10 minutes.
Add the drained canned white beans and pasta and cook for the time indicated on the package, stirring often.
Let rest for 2 minutes and serve piping hot.

polenta-champignons-tomate.title: Creamy polenta with button mushrooms and tomato
steps: Sauté the sliced onion in 2 tablespoons of olive oil, then add the sliced button mushrooms and garlic and cook for 8 minutes.
Add the chopped tomatoes, oregano and half the salt, then simmer for 10 minutes.
Bring 1.2 litres of water to a boil with the remaining salt, pour in the polenta in a stream and cook, stirring, for the time indicated on the package.
Stir in the remaining olive oil and serve the polenta topped with the sauce.

piccata-dinde-citron-pates.title: Turkey piccata with lemon and pasta
steps: Cook the pasta and lightly flour the salted turkey escalopes.
Brown the escalopes for 4 minutes on each side in olive oil and half the butter, then set aside.
Pour the lemon juice and 10 cl water into the pan, scrape up the browned bits, then add the remaining butter.
Return the escalopes to the sauce for 1 minute, sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve with the pasta.

penne-arrabbiata.title: Penne all'arrabbiata
steps: Gently heat the olive oil with the sliced garlic and chili.
Add the chopped tomatoes and salt and simmer for 12 minutes.
Cook the pasta, drain and toss with the sauce.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve.

mafe-boeuf-cacahuete.title: Beef mafé with peanut butter
steps: Brown the beef cubes in oil with the sliced onion.
Add the chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, chili, salt and 50 cl water, then simmer for 45 minutes.
Mix the peanut butter with a little sauce, add it along with the carrots and sweet potatoes cut into large pieces.
Simmer for 30 minutes on low heat, stirring to prevent the sauce from sticking.
Cook the rice and serve with the mafé.

thieboudienne-cabillaud-riz.title: Thieboudienne with cod and tomato rice
steps: Blend the parsley, garlic, chili and half the salt, then rub the fish pieces with this mixture.
Sauté the sliced onion in oil, add the tomato paste and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Pour in 1 litre water, add the carrots, white cabbage and eggplant cut into large pieces and the remaining salt, then cook for 20 minutes.
Add the fish, cook for 10 minutes, then keep the fish and vegetables warm.
Add the rinsed rice to the broth, cover and cook for 20 minutes on low heat.
Serve the rice with the fish, vegetables and lemon wedges.

misir-wat-lentilles-corail.title: Misir wat, Ethiopian red lentils
steps: Sauté the chopped onion for 10 minutes in oil, then add the garlic and grated fresh ginger.
Add the paprika, chili, turmeric and tomato paste and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the rinsed red lentils, 80 cl water and salt, then simmer for 20 minutes, stirring.
Cook the rice and serve with the lentils.

jollof-riz-poulet.title: Jollof, tomato rice with chicken
steps: Brown the chicken in oil in a Dutch oven, then set aside.
Blend the chopped tomatoes, bell pepper, onion, garlic and fresh ginger.
Pour this mixture into the Dutch oven with tomato paste, curry, chili and salt, then cook for 10 minutes.
Add the rinsed rice, chicken and 40 cl water, cover and cook for 25 minutes on low heat, stirring once.
Let rest for 5 minutes covered and serve.

bricks-thon-oeuf-persil.title: Bricks with tuna and egg
steps: Mix the drained canned tuna and chopped parsley, then season with salt.
Place this mixture in the center of each brick pastry sheet, form a hollow and crack an egg into it.
Fold the pastry sheet into a triangle without breaking the egg.
Brown in hot oil for 2 minutes on each side, then drain on paper towels.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges.

salade-mechouia-poivrons-tomates.title: Mechouia salad, grilled bell peppers and tomatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 230 °C and roast the whole bell peppers and tomatoes for 35 minutes, turning them.
Let cool covered, then peel and remove the seeds.
Chop the vegetables with the garlic.
Season with cumin, lemon juice, olive oil and salt, then garnish with olives and serve chilled.

zaalouk-aubergines-tomates.title: Zaalouk, eggplant and tomato caviar
steps: Cut the eggplants into small cubes and the tomatoes into dice.
Sauté the garlic in the oil with the spices.
Add the eggplants, tomatoes and salt, cover and cook 25 minutes over medium heat, stirring.
Mash with a fork, add the chopped fresh coriander and the lemon juice, then serve warm or cold.

carottes-cumin-citron-marocaines.title: Moroccan carrots with cumin and lemon
steps: Cook the carrots in slices for 10 minutes in salted water, they should stay firm, then drain.
Mix the crushed garlic, spices, lemon juice and oil.
Pour over the carrots, add the chopped parsley and serve chilled.

fattouch-pita-grillee.title: Fattoush, Lebanese salad with grilled pita
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, cut the pita bread into pieces and bake for 8 minutes until crispy.
Cut the tomatoes, cucumber and radishes, chop the green salad and herbs.
Mix the lemon juice, oil and salt.
Combine everything at the last moment with the pita pieces and serve.

mouhammara-poivrons-noix.title: Muhammara, bell pepper and nut spread
steps: Preheat the oven to 230 °C and bake the whole bell peppers for 30 minutes, then peel and deseed them.
Blend the bell peppers with the nuts, breadcrumbs, tomato paste, garlic, cumin, chili and salt.
Add the lemon juice and oil, blend again and serve chilled.

baba-ghanouj-aubergines-tahini.title: Baba ghanouj, smoked eggplant with sesame paste
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C, prick the eggplants and bake them whole for 40 minutes.
Scoop out the flesh and let it drain in a colander.
Mash the flesh with the sesame paste, lemon juice, crushed garlic, cumin and salt.
Drizzle with oil, sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve chilled.

samoussas-legumes-four.title: Baked vegetable samosas
steps: Cook the potatoes in small cubes for 10 minutes in salted water, then drain.
Sauté the chopped onion in 1 spoon of oil with the garam masala, then add the potatoes, frozen peas and chopped fresh coriander.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C and cut each brick pastry sheet in half.
Fold each half-sheet into a triangle around a spoonful of filling, place on a baking tray and brush with the remaining oil.
Bake for 15 minutes, until the samosas are golden.

bhajis-oignons-pois-chiches.title: Onion bhajis with chickpea flour
steps: Finely slice the onions and chop the fresh coriander.
Mix the flour, spices, salt and about 12 cl water to get a thick batter, then add the onions and coriander.
Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and flatten slightly.
Cook 3 minutes on each side, drain on paper towels and serve hot.

rouleaux-printemps-crevettes.title: Shrimp spring rolls
steps: Cook the peeled shrimp for 3 minutes in boiling water, then drain, and soak the rice vermicelli according to the package.
Grate the carrots and chop the green salad.
Dip a rice paper sheet for a few seconds in lukewarm water and place it on a damp towel.
Fill with green salad, vermicelli, carrots, herbs and shrimp, then roll tightly, folding in the sides.
Mix the nuoc mam, lime juice, sugar and 3 spoons of water and serve as a dipping sauce.

salade-mangue-crevettes-citron-vert.title: Mango and shrimp salad with lime
steps: Sear the shrimp for 3 minutes in oil, then let cool.
Cut the mango and cucumber into dice.
Mix the juice of the limes, nuoc mam and chili.
Combine everything with the chopped fresh coriander and serve chilled.

soupe-coco-poulet-citron-vert.title: Thai soup with chicken, coconut and lime
steps: Bring the coconut milk to a simmer with 50 cl water, the fresh ginger in slices and the chili.
Add the chicken in thin slices and the sliced button mushrooms, then cook for 10 minutes.
Add the nuoc mam, sugar and lime juice.
Sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander and serve.

guacamole-chips-tortilla.title: Guacamole and tortilla chips
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, cut the tortilla wraps into triangles, brush with oil and bake for 8 minutes.
Mash the avocados with a fork with the lime juice and salt.
Add the tomato in small dice, finely chopped onion and chopped fresh coriander.
Serve immediately with the chips.

esquites-mais-citron-vert.title: Esquites, sautéed corn with lime
steps: Brown the drained canned corn in the butter for 6 minutes over high heat.
Off the heat, add the thick crème fraîche, lime juice, paprika and salt.
Divide into small bowls, crumble the feta and sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander.

caponata-aubergines-olives.title: Sicilian Caponata with Eggplant and Olives
steps: Brown the eggplant cubes in 3 tablespoons of oil for 15 minutes, then set aside.
Sauté the sliced onion in the remaining oil, add the chopped tomatoes and salt, and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the eggplant, olives, sugar, and vinegar, then cook for another 10 minutes.
Let cool, add the basil, and serve at room temperature.

panzanella-tomates-pain.title: Panzanella, Tuscan Tomato and Bread Salad
steps: Cut the day-old baguette into cubes.
Cut the tomatoes and cucumber into pieces and slice the onion thinly, then mix them with the salt.
Add the bread, vinegar, and oil, mix, and let sit for 10 minutes so the bread soaks up the juices.
Add the basil and serve.

minestrone-legumes-haricots.title: Minestrone with Vegetables and White Beans
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and garlic (clove) in oil.
Add the diced carrots and potatoes, chopped tomatoes, salt, and 1.2 liters of water, then cook for 15 minutes.
Add the diced zucchini, chopped green beans, and drained canned white beans, then cook for another 15 minutes.
Add the chopped basil and serve.

salade-concombre-sesame.title: Cucumber Salad with Sesame
steps: Lightly crush the cucumbers, then cut them into irregular pieces.
Mix the tamari, vinegar, sesame oil, sugar, crushed garlic (clove), and chili.
Toss with the cucumbers, sprinkle with sesame seeds, and serve chilled.

kachumbari-tomates-oignon.title: Kachumbari, East African Tomato and Onion Salad
steps: Slice the onion very thinly and let it sit for 5 minutes in the lime juice with salt.
Dice the tomatoes and cucumber into small pieces.
Mix everything with the chopped fresh coriander and chili, then serve chilled.

soupe-arachide-patate-douce.title: West African Peanut and Sweet Potato Soup
steps: Sauté the sliced onion in oil with garlic (clove) and grated fresh ginger.
Add the cubed sweet potatoes, chopped tomatoes, chili, salt, and 1 liter of water, then cook for 20 minutes.
Add the peanut butter and blend until you get a smooth soup.
Reheat for 2 minutes while stirring and serve.

mouhalabieh-fleur-oranger-pistache.title: Mouhalabieh with Orange Blossom Water and Pistachios
steps: Dissolve the cornstarch in 10 cl of cold milk.
Bring the rest of the milk to a simmer with the sugar, pour in the cornstarch mixture, and stir for 3 minutes until thickened.
Off the heat, add the orange blossom water and pour into small bowls.
Let set for 2 hours in the fridge and sprinkle with crushed shelled pistachios.

salade-oranges-cannelle.title: Orange Salad with Cinnamon
steps: Peel the oranges and cut them into thin slices.
Arrange them on a platter and drizzle with orange blossom water.
Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon, then top with chopped mint and serve chilled.

ghribas-noix-de-coco.title: Coconut Ghribas
steps: Preheat the oven to 170 °C.
Mix the grated coconut, semolina, sugar, vanilla sugar, baking powder, and eggs, then let rest for 10 minutes.
Form balls, place them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and flatten them slightly.
Bake for 15 minutes until just golden and let cool on the baking sheet.

baklava-noix-miel.title: Baklava with Nuts and Honey
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C, roughly chop the nuts with the sugar and cinnamon, and melt the butter.
Cut the brick pastry sheets to fit a small baking dish, then alternate buttered sheets and nuts, finishing with a sheet.
Cut into diamonds and bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden.
Heat the honey with the lemon juice and 5 cl of water, then pour over the hot baklava.
Let rest for several hours before serving.

gajar-halwa-carottes-pistaches.title: Gajar Halwa, Indian Carrot Dessert
steps: Finely grate the carrots.
Cook them for 25 minutes in the milk, stirring, until the milk is absorbed.
Add the sugar, butter, cinnamon, and raisins, then cook for 8 minutes until the mixture pulls away from the sides of the pan.
Serve warm, sprinkled with crushed shelled pistachios.

riz-coco-mangue.title: Rice with Coconut Milk and Mango
steps: Rinse the rice, then cook it for 20 minutes over low heat with the coconut milk, 30 cl of water, sugar, and salt, stirring often.
Let rest for 10 minutes covered.
Slice the mango and serve over the warm rice.

che-bananes-coco.title: Chè, Vietnamese Bananas with Coconut Milk
steps: Bring the coconut milk to a simmer with 20 cl water and the sugar.
Add the bananas in slices and cook for 5 minutes.
Dissolve the cornstarch in a little cold water, pour in while stirring and let thicken for 1 minute.
Serve warm, sprinkled with sesame seeds.

churros-four-cannelle.title: Oven-Baked Churros with Cinnamon
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and bring 25 cl water to a boil with the butter and salt.
Off the heat, add the flour all at once, stir vigorously, then dry out for 1 minute over low heat.
Incorporate the eggs one by one until you get a smooth dough.
Pipe sticks onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 22 minutes.
Roll the hot churros in the sugar mixed with cinnamon and serve immediately.

flan-caramel-oeufs.title: Egg and Caramel Flan
steps: Preheat the oven to 160 °C and melt 80 g sugar dry until you get an amber caramel, then pour it into a mold.
Warm the milk with the vanilla sugar.
Whisk the eggs with the remaining sugar, then pour in the milk while stirring.
Pour over the caramel, place the mold in a dish of hot water and bake for 40 minutes.
Let cool, chill for 3 hours and unmold.

panna-cotta-fruits-rouges-agar.title: Panna Cotta with Agar-Agar and Berries
steps: Mix the single cream, milk, 40 g sugar, vanilla sugar and agar-agar cold.
Bring to a boil and let boil for 2 minutes, stirring.
Divide into glasses, let cool, then chill for 2 hours.
Cook the frozen berries for 5 minutes with the remaining sugar, let cool and spoon over the panna cottas.

tiramisu-cafe-classique.title: Classic Coffee Tiramisu
steps: Dissolve the instant coffee in 25 cl hot water and let cool.
Whisk the yolks with the sugar until the mixture whitens, then fold in the mascarpone.
Beat the egg whites until stiff and gently fold them in.
Quickly dip the shortbread biscuits in the coffee and layer in a dish with the cream.
Chill for 4 hours and dust with cocoa before serving.

thiakry-semoule-yaourt.title: Thiakry, Sweet Semolina with Yogurt
steps: Pour 20 cl boiling water over the semolina, cover for 5 minutes and fluff with a fork.
Mix the plain yogurts, milk, sugar, vanilla sugar and cinnamon.
Add the semolina and raisins, mix and chill for 1 hour.
Sprinkle with grated coconut and serve cold.

ananas-gingembre-citron-vert.title: Fresh Pineapple with Ginger and Lime
steps: Peel the pineapple, remove the core and cut the flesh into small pieces.
Mix the grated fresh ginger, the zest and juice of the lime and the sugar.
Pour over the pineapple, add chopped mint and serve cold.

gateau-cacao-vegan.title: Vegan Cocoa Cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and grease a pan.
Mix the flour, cocoa powder, sugar, vanilla sugar, baking powder and salt.
Add the sunflower oil, vinegar and 20 cl water, then whisk just until smooth.
Pour into the pan, bake for 30 minutes and let cool slightly before unmolding.

shrikhand-yaourt-mangue.title: Shrikhand, Drained Yogurt with Mango
steps: Pour the plain yogurts into a sieve lined with a clean cloth and let drain for 3 hours in the fridge.
Mix the drained yogurt with the sugar and cinnamon.
Divide into bowls, add diced mango and chopped shelled pistachios.

baghrir-crepes-mille-trous.title: Baghrir, Moroccan Thousand-Hole Pancakes
steps: Blend the semolina, flour, sugar, salt, both yeasts and 45 cl lukewarm water for 1 minute.
Let the batter rest for 30 minutes at room temperature, until it foams.
Pour a small ladleful into a hot non-stick pan and cook without flipping until the top is dry and covered with holes.
Melt the butter with the honey and drizzle over the pancakes.

foul-feves-citron-cumin.title: Foul, Fava Beans with Lemon and Cumin
steps: Reheat the drained canned fava beans for 8 minutes with 10 cl water.
Roughly mash with the crushed garlic (clove), cumin, salt and lemon juice.
Serve drizzled with olive oil, with diced tomato and chopped parsley.

pita-zaatar-huile-olive.title: Pitas with Zaatar and Raw Vegetables
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and mix the zaatar with the olive oil.
Spread this mixture on the pita bread and bake for 6 minutes.
Serve hot with sliced tomato and cucumber and mint.

upma-semoule-legumes.title: Upma, savory semolina with vegetables
steps: Toast the semolina dry for 3 minutes in a pan, then set aside.
Sauté the cumin, chopped onion, diced carrot, and grated fresh ginger in oil.
Add the frozen peas, turmeric, salt, and 55 cl water, then bring to a boil.
Sprinkle in the semolina, stir for 2 minutes, cover off the heat for 3 minutes, and drizzle with lemon juice.

omelette-masala-tomate.title: Masala omelette with tomato
steps: Beat the eggs with salt and spices.
Add the chopped onion, diced tomato, and chopped fresh coriander.
Cook in oil over medium heat in two batches, folding the omelette while still slightly runny.

congee-riz-poulet-gingembre.title: Congee, rice porridge with chicken and ginger
steps: Bring the rinsed rice to a boil with 2 liters of water, sliced fresh ginger, salt, and the whole chicken fillet.
Simmer for 15 minutes, remove the chicken, and shred it.
Continue cooking the rice for 35 minutes on low heat, stirring, until you get a porridge.
Return the chicken and serve with tamari, sesame oil, and sliced spring onion.

tamagoyaki-omelette-roulee.title: Tamagoyaki, Japanese rolled omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with sugar, tamari, and sliced spring onion.
Pour a thin layer into an oiled pan over medium heat, then roll the omelette to one side when set.
Pour another layer under the roll and repeat until finished.
Let cool slightly and cut into slices.

huevos-rancheros-haricots.title: Huevos rancheros with red beans
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and garlic (clove) in oil, add the chopped tomatoes, cumin, chili, and salt, then cook for 8 minutes.
Add the drained red beans and reheat.
Make 4 wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook for 5 minutes.
Warm the tortilla wraps in a pan, top with sauce and an egg, then sprinkle with chopped fresh coriander.

frittata-legumes-four.title: Vegetable frittata
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C.
Sauté the onion, bell pepper, and zucchini diced for 8 minutes in oil in an ovenproof pan.
Beat the eggs with salt and chopped basil, then pour over the vegetables.
Cook for 2 minutes on the stove, then bake for 12 minutes.

tartines-ricotta-miel-fraises.title: Ricotta toasts with honey and strawberries
steps: Slice the baguette in half lengthwise, then into pieces.
Spread with ricotta.
Top with sliced strawberries and drizzle with honey.

porridge-arachide-banane.title: Peanut butter and banana porridge
steps: Bring the soy drink to a simmer with cinnamon.
Add the oat flakes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring.
Off the heat, stir in the peanut butter.
Serve with sliced bananas.

chia-coco-mangue.title: Chia pudding with coconut and mango
steps: Mix the coconut milk, 20 cl water, sugar, and chia seeds.
Stir again after 10 minutes and chill overnight.
Blend the mango with the juice of the lime.
Serve the pudding with the mango purée.

tofu-brouille-tomate-curcuma.title: Scrambled tofu with tomato and turmeric
steps: Crumble the firm tofu with a fork.
Sauté the sliced spring onion in oil, add turmeric and paprika.
Add the tofu, diced tomato, and salt, then cook for 6 minutes, stirring.

smoothie-mangue-banane-coco.title: Mango, banana and coconut smoothie
steps: Peel the mango and bananas and cut into pieces.
Blend with coconut milk, lime juice, and 30 cl very cold water.
Serve immediately.

puff-puff-beignets.title: Puff-puff, West African doughnuts
steps: Mix the flour, sugar, dried baker's yeast, salt, and 20 cl lukewarm water until you get a thick, sticky dough.
Cover and let rise for 1 hour in a warm place.
Heat oil to a depth of 3 cm in a deep saucepan.
Drop spoonfuls of dough into the oil and fry for 5 minutes, turning, until golden.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.
